styles.desc: 最经典的日式动画上色逻辑：亮部一层、暗部一层，边界锐利，几乎无渐变。特征是大面积纯色块 + 明确的第二阴影，适合还原传统电视动画的干净质感。
styles.note: 想接近手绘动画截图时，务必同时加 anime screencap / anime cel>
styles.demo: 1girl, solo, school uniform, cel shading, flat color, hard shadow, clean lineart, white background, anime screencap, masterpiece
styles.gpt: Classic Japanese cel-shaded anime illustration: a teenage girl in a navy sailor uniform standing in an empty classroom filled with afternoon sunlight. Shade her strictly with the traditional two-tone cel method, one flat base tone for every lit surface succeeded by a single crisp second shadow whose boundary stays razor sharp with no gradient anywhere between them. Surround every form with even-weight dark brown lineart and reduce background desks and window frames to large flat unmodulated color blocks. Restrict the scheme to warm skin, deep navy uniform cloth, muted chalkboard green and pale sunlit wood. Compose a waist-up portrait under flat even lighting free of rim light, bloom or photographic artifacts. Keep the frame clean with no text, logos, watermarks or UI elements.
styles.gptZh: 经典日式赛璐璐动画插画：一名穿藏青色水手服的女中学生站在被午后阳光填满的空教室里。用传统两阶赛璐璐方式上色——每一个受光面先铺一层平涂底色，再压上一块边界锐利的第二阴影，两层之间不允许出现任何渐变。每个形体外面罩一层粗细均匀的深褐色描边线，背景的书桌与窗框一律简化成大块平涂色、不加任何明暗塑造。配色收在暖肤色、深海军蓝校服、哑光黑板绿与浅色木纹这四组内。取半身像构图，平整均匀的光线，不要轮廓光、不要辉光、不要任何摄影感元素。画面保持干净，不要文字、标志、水印或界面元素。
styles.craftEn: The classic Japanese cel logic: one flat tone for the lit side, one for the shadow side, razor-sharp boundary, almost no gradient anywhere. Large unmodulated colour blocks with a single clearly readable second shadow. This is the clean, economical finish of traditional television animation.
styles.craftZh: 最经典的日式动画上色逻辑：亮部一层、暗部一层，边界锐利，几乎无渐变。特征是大面积纯色块 + 明确的第二阴影，适合还原传统电视动画的干净质感。

styles.desc: 2015 年后主流商业插画的画法：在平涂基础上叠加柔和渐变，高光用喷枪柔边处理，皮肤通透，头发会有多层高光环。视觉比纯赛璐璐更立体、更「贵」。
styles.note: 这是当前二次元商业插画的默认画法，适合角色立绘与卡面
styles.demo: 1girl, long silver hair, soft shading, gradient skin, glossy eyes, blurred background bokeh, digital painting, masterpiece, best quality
styles.gpt: Contemporary digital anime illustration finished with soft airbrush shading: a young woman with long silver hair and glossy eyes seated by a window at golden hour. Build the rendering from many layered gradients instead of hard cel boundaries, blending every transition until it disappears, and layer broad blurred highlight rings through the hair along with a translucent glow across the cheekbones. Give the irises several overlapping highlight discs and a soft bounce light along the lower lid. Soften the background into natural bokeh with slow drifting dust particles for commercial polish. Compose a chest-up portrait lit warmly and gently. Include no text, logos, watermarks or signature anywhere in the image.
styles.gptZh: 当代数码动漫插画，以喷枪柔光上色收尾：一名长银发、眼睛有明显高光的年轻女性，在黄金时刻坐在窗边。用多层渐变堆出体积，而不是用硬边的赛璐璐分色，每一处过渡都混到看不出接缝；头发上铺几道宽而模糊的高光环，颧骨上横一层半透明反光。虹膜里叠两三枚错位的高光圆点，下眼睑带一道柔和的反光。把背景虚化成自然散景，飘着缓慢移动的尘埃粒子，做出商业插画的精致感。取胸像构图，光线温暖柔和。画面里不要出现任何文字、标志、水印或签名。
styles.craftEn: The dominant commercial illustration finish since roughly 2015: flat base shading with soft gradients layered over it, airbrush-softened highlight edges, translucent skin rendering, and several separate highlight passes through the hair. Reads more dimensional and more expensive than pure cel.
styles.craftZh: 2015 年后主流商业插画的画法：在平涂基础上叠加柔和渐变，高光用喷枪柔边处理，皮肤通透，头发会有多层高光环。视觉比纯赛璐璐更立体、更「贵」。

styles.desc: 保留明显笔触，用厚重叠加的颜料感塑造体积，是二次元里最厚重的一支。常见于轻小说封面、机设稿与幻想战争题材，画面信息密度极高。
styles.note: 厚涂对模型要求高，SD1.5 出图容易脏，建议 SDXL / Flux 以上
styles.demo: 1girl, fantasy armor, thick paint, oily brush strokes, strong lighting, detailed background, oil painting texture, dramatic shadows
styles.gpt: Painterly anime illustration executed in thick impasto oil technique: a battered knight seated beside a dying campfire at dusk. Apply pigment in visible directional strokes rather than smooth fills so that ridges of paint physically catch the firelight along armor bevels, and construct every shadow from dense warm brown underlayers. Maintain an old-master value structure with deep integrated shadow masses and one dominant warm key light blooming off the front plate. Let edges stay broken and searching rather than slick, with coarse canvas tooth faintly visible through the dark background. Compose a three-quarter view with focus falling off sharply into the trees behind. Include no text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 以厚重油画堆叠技法执行的绘画感动漫插画：黄昏时分，一名满身战痕的骑士坐在将熄的篝火旁。颜料以看得见方向的笔触铺陈，而不是抹成光滑色块，让颜料的物理脊线沿着甲片的倒角接住火光；每一处暗面都由厚实的暖棕色底子叠出来。保持古典大师式的明暗结构：暗部是大块融合的厚重色团，前甲上留一处主导的暖色主光溢开。边缘保持断续、像在搜索合适的位置，不要光滑精致的处理，暗背景里隐约透出粗粝的画布肌理。取四分之三侧视角，焦点硬生生收进身后的树林。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Keeps the brushstroke visible and builds volume through heavy opaque layering, so the paint itself carries the form. The thickest of the anime-family finishes; common on light-novel covers, mechanical design sheets and fantasy war subjects, at very high information density.
styles.craftZh: 保留明显笔触，用厚重叠加的颜料感塑造体积，是二次元里最厚重的一支。常见于轻小说封面、机设稿与幻想战争题材，画面信息密度极高。

styles.desc: 低饱和、高透明度，颜料在纸上自然晕开的边缘，能看见纸纹和颗粒。情绪偏温柔怀旧，非常适合抒情系插画、绘本封面。
styles.note: 叠加 watercolor (medium) 或 watercolor (style)，两种写法都能显著强化效果
styles.demo: landscape, sakura, transparent watercolor, pigment bleed, wet-on-wet, paper texture, soft pastel palette, gentle light, illustration
styles.gpt: Transparent watercolor anime illustration: a girl in a straw hat walking along a puddled seaside path just after rain. Use nothing but transparent washes, allowing the white of the paper itself to serve as the brightest highlight and building every tone by layering diluted pigment so colors mix optically on the sheet instead of being premixed on a palette. Let wet-on-wet blooms soften the horizon line and pool unevenly at the hem of the skirt while granulation settles quietly into the shadows. Keep a light graphite under-drawing visible beneath the wash. Leave generous untouched paper around the figure and add no border or frame. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 透明水彩插画：一名戴草帽的女孩在雨后初晴的海边小路上行走。整幅只用透明水彩——纸的白就是最亮的高光，颜色在湿纸上自然洇开，边缘留得住水痕。加入逐层稀释的颜料叠加，湿画湿让地平线一带柔化，暗部让颜料自然颗粒沉积。水彩底下透出淡淡的石墨起稿线。留出大片未着色的纸白。整体低饱和、温柔怀旧。不要文字、边框或水印。
styles.craftEn: Low-saturation and highly transparent, with pigment edges blooming naturally into the paper; paper grain and granulation stay visible. Mood is gentle and nostalgic, well suited to lyrical illustration and picture-book covers.
styles.craftZh: 低饱和、高透明度，颜料在纸上自然晕开的边缘，能看见纸纹和颗粒。情绪偏温柔怀旧，非常适合抒情系插画、绘本封面。

styles.zh: 粗描线稿 / 线稿至上
styles.desc: 以线的粗细变化主导画面，线本身就是造型语言。粗轮廓 + 细部线形成节奏，代表是扳机社成立之前的老派作画。
styles.note: 配合 lineart, monochrome 可直接生成线稿，适合后期自己上色
styles.demo: portrait of a girl, lineart, monochrome, white background, varying line weight, clean lines, high resolution
styles.gpt: Bold lineart-driven anime illustration with almost no applied color: a swordsman caught mid-draw in one explosive moment. Make the drawing itself the subject by varying line weight decisively, loading heavy black strokes onto the forms closest to the viewer and thinning them as shapes recede, and leaving deliberate open gaps and slight overshoot where a hand would naturally break the contour. Add rough searching pencil strokes in a few places and one passing of light hatching in the deepest shadows only, plus a single flat gray tone as spot accent. Stage it diagonally against a nearly empty background. Include no text, speech bubbles, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 以线的粗细变化主导画面的粗描线稿：一名剑客在拔剑的瞬间被定格。以自信的手绘线条塑造造型，近处的形体用粗黑厚重的线，远处的细节迅速收细，只用一层浅浅的灰调交代最深的暗部，其余地方保持留白。线条有轻微的抖动与收笔处的出头，不要机器般均匀。整体几乎不填色，只在人物受光面留一小块平涂灰色。斜线构图，背景大面积空白。画面不要文字、对白框或水印。
styles.craftEn: Line weight drives the whole image — the line itself is the modelling language. A heavy outer contour against fine interior lines creates rhythm; representative of the pre-Trigger-era studio manner.
styles.craftZh: 以线的粗细变化主导画面，线本身就是造型语言。粗轮廓 + 细部线形成节奏，代表是扳机社成立之前的老派作画。

styles.zh: 半写实 / 真人向动画
styles.desc: 介于动漫与写实之间：人脸比例接近真人（略微收下颌、放大眼），五官有细节但不完全写实。代表今敏、细田守剧场版的角色处理。
styles.note: 控制不好会掉进 uncanny valley，建议把 anime 权重压低而不是删除
styles.demo: portrait, semi-realistic, anime style, detailed face, subtle skin texture, cinematic lighting, realistic proportions
styles.gpt: Semi-realistic anime illustration: a young man in a tailored wool coat waiting on a rainy city street at night. Render him with convincing human anatomy and believable skin, pores along the nose, faint subsurface redness at the ears and cheeks, and a varied specular response between forehead and jaw, while retaining the stylized refinement of anime in the eyes, hair silhouette and line of the chin. Use soft ambient occlusion beneath the brow and collar rather than graphic cel shadows. Let practical street lamps act as the only light sources with correct falloff and long smeared colored reflections across wet asphalt. Compose a cinematic medium shot. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 半写实风格的动漫人物：一名二十岁左右的男性站在旧公寓的走廊上。脸部比例接近真人——下颌略收、眼部放大，五官保留细节但不做完全写实的处理。皮肤上有自然的毛孔与细微的油光，头发用成束的写实发丝而不是色块来画，衣服能看到织物的褶皱与纹理。色调偏灰，饱和度压低，用侧窗光造出明确的面部明暗过渡。整体介于动画与真人摄影之间，不要塑料感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Sits between anime and photoreal: facial proportions close to a real person (jaw slightly narrowed, eyes slightly enlarged), features detailed but not fully rendered. Typical of character design in auteur theatrical features.
styles.craftZh: 介于动漫与写实之间：人脸比例接近真人（略微收下颌、放大眼），五官有细节但不完全写实。代表今敏、细田守剧场版的角色处理。

styles.desc: 头身比压缩到 2～3 头身，手足简化，五官集中在下半脸。表情幅度夸张，适合表情包、吉祥物、周边设计。
styles.note: sd character / chibi 在 SD 系 + NAI 权重都很吃；MJ 里用 tiny cute character 更稳
styles.demo: chibi catgirl, super deformed, big head, tiny arms, simple background, pastel colors, sticker style, white outline
styles.gpt: Chibi super-deformed anime character design: a cheerful cat-eared girl holding an ice cream cone taller than her own body. Compress the proportions to roughly two head-lengths in total with an enormous rounded head, small stubby limbs and simplified mitten hands, keeping the eyes huge, sparkling and set low on the face beside a small bright mouth. Render everything with simple clean shapes, minimal shading and bright saturated toy-like colors so the silhouette reads instantly even at icon size. Center her against a plain pastel circle on open ground with no additional props. Include no background clutter, no text, logos, watermarks or UI frames.
styles.gptZh: Q 版 / 超变形角色立绘：一名抱着冰淇淋的猫耳少女。头身比压到二头身，头部明显放大、四肢短小，手指与脚趾都简化成圆润的小疙瘩。脸部把五官压到最简：两只大眼睛占满上半张脸，嘴缩成一个小点，鼻子基本省略。头顶有一根呆毛微微翘起。服装细节简化为色块与一条描边，但配色保持鲜明。背景是纯色加几个圆形装饰，用贴纸式的白色外轮廓把人物从背景里托出来。整体明快可爱。画面不要文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Head-to-body ratio compressed to about two or three heads, hands and feet simplified, facial features crowded into the lower half of the face. Exaggerated expression range; built for reaction images, mascots and merchandise.
styles.craftZh: 头身比压缩到 2～3 头身，手足简化，五官集中在下半脸。表情幅度夸张，适合表情包、吉祥物、周边设计。

styles.desc: 纯黑白 + 网点纸（screentone）+ 集中线，还原纸质漫画印刷感。注意 AI 生成的文字是乱码，对话气泡要后期加。
styles.note: 文字一律后期用排版软件补，不要在 prompt 里指望生成正确日文
styles.demo: two characters arguing, manga panel, monochrome, screentone, heavy inking, dramatic speed lines, black and white, comic page
styles.gpt: Black-and-white manga page layout: three stacked rectangular panels narrating one wordless beat of a rooftop confrontation. Execute entirely in ink using solid black fills, precise cross-hatching, blown highlight shapes and mechanical screentone gradients for mid-values, with converging speed lines driving the eye toward the action. Separate the panels with clean black borders and generous gutters, and open one full-bleed borderless splash moment across the lower third. Keep composition readable from top to bottom and rely on silhouette separation so black masses never muddy into one another. Leave any speech balloons empty. Include no dialogue, logos, watermarks or color.
styles.gptZh: 黑白漫画页：三格横向分镜，讲述屋顶上的一场无言对峙。全部用黑白：暗部用实心黑块，中间调靠交叉排线，亮部直接留白；再用机械感的网点纸做出灰阶过渡。对话框留空或直接省略，不要写任何字。格与格之间留足白色沟槽，分格线为粗细一致的干净黑框。竖向的集中线强化对峙的紧绷感，下三分之一做一整幅跨格的出血格，放大一个关键动作的瞬间。页面整体保持黑白，不要任何彩色、不要文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Pure black and white plus screentone dots and concentrated line, reproducing the feel of printed paper comics. Note that AI-generated lettering comes out as garbled glyphs — speech balloons must be added in post.
styles.craftZh: 纯黑白 + 网点纸（screentone）+ 集中线，还原纸质漫画印刷感。注意 AI 生成的文字是乱码，对话气泡要后期加。

styles.desc: 强调一笔成形的运笔、留白与浓淡干湿，最忌满幅填色。与武侠、仙侠、禅意题材天然契合。
styles.note: 留白是精髓，构图里务必写 simple composition, negative space
styles.demo: lone crane in shallow water, wind-bent reeds, sumi-e, ink wash painting, black ink on rice paper, negative space, one red seal square, minimal colors
styles.gpt: Sumi-e ink wash painting: a lone crane standing in shallow water beside wind-bent reeds. Work almost entirely in black ink modulated only by water, drawing the reed stems and crane legs as unhesitating single strokes that taper from loaded bristle to dry tip, and washing the far bank into soft gray bleed. Allow absorbent rice paper to drink the pigment so every edge feathers naturally, and leave vast regions of untouched white standing in for mist and open water so that negative space carries nearly a third of the composition. Place one small red seal square in a corner. No modern text, logos or photographic effects.
styles.gptZh: 水墨 / 墨绘：一只白鹤立在浅水中，苇叶被风吹弯。用一笔成形的手法画出鹤与苇，远岸洇成淡灰，大片留白当作水与雾——留白是水墨语言的呼吸，不是没画完。墨色浓淡分明：鹤顶的一点朱红是全画唯一的颜色。构图取横长形，视线从左下引向右上，题款位置留空。整体是墨在宣纸上的渗化效果。不要文字、书法或印章。
styles.craftEn: Emphasises single-stroke brushwork, reserved white space, and the wet-to-dry range of the ink. Filling the whole frame with colour is the cardinal mistake here. Natively suited to wuxia, xianxia and contemplative subject matter.
styles.craftZh: 强调一笔成形的运笔、留白与浓淡干湿，最忌满幅填色。与武侠、仙侠、禅意题材天然契合。

styles.desc: 平涂色块 + 粗黑轮廓 + 和纸质感，装饰性强。注意：这是日本江户艺术，与中国古代水墨要区分开来写。
styles.note: 想做国风请改用「水墨/国画」，浮世绘整套色感偏装饰 poster 化
styles.demo: lone fisherman on rocky outcrop at dawn, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, bold outlines, flat colors, bokashi sky gradient, washi paper texture, vertical composition
styles.gpt: Ukiyo-e woodblock print: a lone fisherman standing on a rocky outcrop at dawn, with a calm bay and distant hills behind him. Confine yourself to flat blocks of hand-mixed mineral color, indigo, soft vegetable yellow and muted red, each bounded by a confident black key line with no modeling or soft edges anywhere in the image. Let the fibrous tooth of washi paper show through the ink, add faint horizontal bokashi banding across the sky, and admit slight misregistration where a second block landed off its mark. Compose with a dominant diagonal, heavy asymmetry and an empty horizontal band at the horizon. Include one small empty cartouche. No readable characters, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 浮世绘木版画：一名渔夫独自站在清晨的礁石上。整幅限定在平涂色块内——靛蓝、蔬菜黄与暗红，每一块都由自信的黑色轮廓线界定边界，画面里任何地方都不做明暗塑造与柔化边缘。天空做横向的渐层（版画特有的晕染），墨要透出和纸的纤维肌理，允许第二块颜色套印时略微错位。构图取竖幅，一条主对角线主导画面，大面积不对称，天际线位置留一条空的横带留白。文字位置留空，不要可读字符、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Flat colour areas, heavy black contour, and washi paper texture, with strong decorative character. Keep it distinct from Chinese classical ink wash: this one is Edo-period Japanese, and should be described as block-printed rather than brushed.
styles.craftZh: 平涂色块 + 粗黑轮廓 + 和纸质感，装饰性强。注意：这是日本江户艺术，与中国古代水墨要区分开来写。

styles.desc: 低分辨率网格 + 有限色板 + 抖动过渡。讲究每个像素都手摆，适合怀旧游戏、地标与界面美术资源。
styles.note: 生成后用最近邻放大，别用双线性插值，否则像素糊成一团
styles.demo: fantasy village, pixel art, 16-bit style, limited color palette, dithering, top-down view, crisp pixels
styles.gpt: Pixel art game sprite scene: a small armored hero standing in a torchlit cave, rendered at true one-to-one pixel resolution. Restrict the palette to roughly sixteen deliberate colors with no anti-aliasing blended between them, and place every individual pixel by hand, using ordered dithering to grade the torch light falloff across the cavern walls and cluster dithering for ambient shadow. Give the sprite a dark outline, exactly three shades of value per material, and a silhouette that stays readable at thumbnail size. Keep all elements aligned to one consistent pixel grid. Add no blurring, no filters, no text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 像素画游戏场景：一名小型铠甲角色站在被火把照亮的洞穴里。所有画面严格按一比一的真实像素网格绘制，不做任何抗锯齿处理。色板限制在约十六色之内；火光的明暗衰减用有序抖动表现，环境阴影用簇状抖动过渡。角色带深色外描边，每种材质只用三个明暗层次。缩小到图标尺寸时剪影依然认得出来。整体保持像素格清晰可见，不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Low-resolution grid, limited palette, ordered dithering for transitions. Every pixel is deliberately placed. Suited to retro games, landmarks and interface art.
styles.craftZh: 低分辨率网格 + 有限色板 + 抖动过渡。讲究每个像素都手摆，适合怀旧游戏、地标与界面美术资源。

styles.desc: 主体压成纯黑（或单色）色块，靠背景大面积留白/渐变衬托轮廓。海报感极强，常用于电影式构图。
styles.note: 轮廓要干净，主体加 rim light / 关节处留光才不会糊成一坨
styles.demo: samurai silhouette against giant red sun, negative space, backlit, rim light, minimal composition, poster style
styles.gpt: Silhouette and negative-space anime composition: a girl standing alone on a rain-slicked city crossing at night, rendered almost entirely as a black shape. Backlight her with warm shopfront glow that picks out only a thin rim of hair and shoulder while every interior detail dissolves, and let the surrounding space carry the information through smeared pavement reflections, drifting rain streaks and distant lit windows. Limit the scheme to deep blue-black plus a single accent color. Compose so the figure occupies a small part of a very large empty frame, honoring the negative space intentionally. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 剪影与负空间构图：一名女孩独自站在夜晚被雨打湿的城市斑马线上。主体几乎完全沉在暗部，只在头发与肩线上留一道极细的轮廓光勾出边缘；深蓝黑的底色里只用一处暖色作为点缀。人物在画面中占比很小，空白占满其余空间——空白是被主动经营的构图，不是忘了画。地面湿滑，映出零星的光斑。整体克制、安静、有余味。画面不要文字、字母、招牌或水印。
styles.craftEn: The subject is compressed into a single solid black or single-hue mass, read against generous empty or graded background space. Extremely strong poster quality; common in cinematic composition.
styles.craftZh: 主体压成纯黑（或单色）色块，靠背景大面积留白/渐变衬托轮廓。海报感极强，常用于电影式构图。

styles.desc: 保留草图阶段的辅助线、复线、噪点，画面像分镜稿或设定集未完成稿。很有「作者性」。
styles.note: 与 clean lineart 互斥，选一个方向，别同时要
styles.demo: character design sheet, pencil sketch, sketchpad paper texture, multiple rough attempts, graphite shading
styles.gpt: Pencil sketch anime drawing left deliberately in draft state: a seated girl resting her chin on one hand, drawn on toned paper. Keep the construction legible, a light circle for the cranium, a center line, a blocked chest cage, and duplicated searching contour lines where the hand corrected the near shoulder. Vary graphite pressure so weight gathers on the underside of forms, smudge a few core shadows with a blending stump, and abandon the far arm and lower sheet unfinished as raw white paper. Add faint kneaded-eraser highlights lifted from the hair. Include no color, no inked lines, no text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 手绘草稿感的铅笔素描：一名女性坐在椅子上，一手托腮。画面保留完整的起稿痕迹——颅骨位置的圆形辅助线、人体中轴线、概括的胸腔块面，近侧肩部有多次重复描摹留下的搜索线。线条本身轻重变化明显，石墨在纸面上压出深浅不一的灰调。核心暗部用擦笔晕开，上半部分维持原始纸白，等于用纸白当高光。下半身刻意不画完，保持纸面原样，只在头发里留几处橡皮擦出的高光。人物着装完整，不要任何文字、标注或签名。
styles.craftEn: Keeps the construction lines, repeated strokes and speckle of an unfinished draft, so the image reads like a storyboard panel or an incomplete design sheet. Strong sense of authorial hand.
styles.craftZh: 保留草图阶段的辅助线、复线、噪点，画面像分镜稿或设定集未完成稿。很有「作者性」。

styles.zh: 高对比霓虹 / 夜景摄影感
styles.desc: 以青紫洋红为主光源，配合湿地反光与边缘光。这是近年最通用的「高级感配方」，几乎万能。
styles.note: 控制霓虹占比，光源超过两种画面就会脏
styles.demo: girl standing in rainy alley, neon signs, cyan and magenta rim light, reflections on wet asphalt, cinematic, detailed background
styles.gpt: High-contrast neon night anime illustration with photographic camera feel: a courier standing at the mouth of a rain-soaked alley in a dense city. Light the scene almost entirely from practical signage, magenta from one wall and cyan from the other, rimming her shoulders and catching the eyelashes, with almost no ambient fill so shadow areas crush toward black. Make every wet surface a broken mirror holding smeared colored reflections, and add gentle lens bloom with slight chromatic fringing toward the frame edges. Compose with strong perspective convergence and heavy atmospheric depth. Put no readable text on the signs, no logos, watermarks or UI overlays.
styles.gptZh: 高对比霓虹夜景：一名单身信使站在雨夜的巷口。左墙打品红光、右墙打青色光，两种色光在人物肩膀与睫毛边缘勾出彩色轮廓光。暗部被压到接近纯黑，湿沥青地面把光拉成一条条竖向的破碎倒影。镜头只允许极轻的辉光，不要过曝的光晕。构图用强透视让巷子向深处收，远处霓虹抽象成不可读的色块光晕。整体潮湿、有电影感。画面不要可读文字、字母或字符，也不要水印。
styles.craftEn: Cyan and magenta carry the key light, supported by wet-ground reflection and rim light. The most general-purpose route to a premium night look at present.
styles.craftZh: 以青紫洋红为主光源，配合湿地反光与边缘光。这是近年最通用的「高级感配方」，几乎万能。

styles.desc: 盖塔、魔神 Z 一代：色偏橘红、纸质感颗粒、机器人造型敦实方正，作画帧数很少（有限动画），人物脸部容易被某些模型误判成老外。
styles.note: 叠一句 limited animation 能明显压出当年的「三帧省成法」手感
styles.demo: super robot, 1970s anime style, retro mecha design, grainy film texture, orange sky, cel painted, limited animation
styles.gpt: Retro 1970s super-robot anime still: a chunky chest-heavy robot with a horned helmet standing against clear sky over a volcanic island. Reproduce the production reality of the period honestly, limited animation staging, flat hand-painted poster-like skies built from broad washes, heavy uniform ink outlines and simplified primary color plating broken by visible panel gaps rather than engraved surface detail. Add coarse 16mm film grain, faint gate weave, and highlights faded warm toward red as old prints do. Compose a heroic low-angle full-body shot with thick black speed lines raking past. Keep it mechanical and hand-made rather than cleanly rendered. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 1970 年代复古机甲动画插画：一台方头方脑的机器人站在黄昏的厂区空地上。造型带着那个年代特有的机械朴素感——外露的活塞管线、铆钉固定的装甲板、几乎没有曲面的直角块面。画法上有明显的赛璐璐痕迹：两阶上色、硬边阴影、大片平涂色。上色偏旧印刷品的陈黄与褪色红，边缘带轻微套印错位。胶片颗粒明显但不遮细节，画面整体偏暖黄，像是从老档案胶卷里翻出来的。天空做横向硬边渐层。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: The late-70s mecha television era: orange-red biased palette, visible film grain, squat and boxy robot silhouettes, and very limited animation with few in-between frames.
styles.craftZh: 盖塔、魔神 Z 一代：色偏橘红、纸质感颗粒、机器人造型敦实方正，作画帧数很少（有限动画），人物脸部容易被某些模型误判成老外。

styles.desc: OVA 兴起到世纪末的巅峰手绘背景：水粉厚涂的背景美术 + 强对比赛璐璐角色 + 胶片颗粒。阿基拉、攻壳前夕、城市猎人这一脉。
styles.note: 背景美术单独强调 detailed background painting, gouache background 效果最好
styles.demo: 1980s anime, detective in trench coat, neon city, detailed gouache background, grainy film still, analog colors, strong contrast
styles.gpt: Golden-age 1980s anime cel animation still: a young heroine leaning on a balcony railing at sunset above a seaside town. Recreate the peak hand-painted look with dense opaque poster-color background art carrying genuine atmospheric depth, characters laid over it in crisp clean line art with two-tone shading, and rich saturated primaries rather than modern pastel keying. Include the analog qualities of an actual film capture, photographic cel grain, slight color registration drift where the camera ran hot, and gentle specular bloom off polished railings and hair. Compose it like a theatrical key visual with unhurried depth. Include no text, logos, watermarks or modern digital effects.
styles.gptZh: 1980 年代黄金赛璐璐动画插画：一名少年剑士站在夕阳下的神社参道前。整个画面保持传统两阶赛璐璐的干净质感——大面积平涂色块、边界锐利的第二阴影、均匀的深色描边。但配色明显是那个年代的审美：高饱和的洋红、青绿与金色的撞色，天空做多段硬边渐层，整体偏暖偏亮。加一层轻微的胶片颗粒与极淡的网点感，但不要重到影响线条。构图正面对称，人物居中略偏下。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: The peak of hand-drawn production from OVA boom to the end of the century: thick gouache background paintings with hard-edged cel characters on top, plus film grain throughout.
styles.craftZh: OVA 兴起到世纪末的巅峰手绘背景：水粉厚涂的背景美术 + 强对比赛璐璐角色 + 胶片颗粒。阿基拉、攻壳前夕、城市猎人这一脉。

styles.desc: 少女革命、EVA、美少女战士、口袋妖怪那个年代：16mm 胶转磁的轻微退色、柔和的暗角、为了省钱的低帧。怀旧杀器。
styles.note: 90 年代 tag 要配合低饱和，纯 bright colorful 会跑偏成现代数码
styles.demo: 1girl, magical girl outfit, 1990s anime style, anime cel, film grain, VHS softness, slightly muted colors, classic anime eyes
styles.gpt: 1990s television anime cel still: a schoolgirl waiting alone at a suburban railway crossing in late afternoon. Capture the exact finish of the decade, slightly desaturated cels composited over detailed painted backgrounds, softer line weight than the eighties, skin tones muted toward warm gray, and the unmistakable softness of analog tape transfer with visible chroma smear and fine scanline grain. Allow occasional dust specks and a hairline cel scratch to drift through the frame. Compose as though lifted from a 4:3 television broadcast with modest staging depth and no compositing tricks. Avoid any modern digital crispness. No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 1990 年代电视动画胶片质感：一名女中学生坐在放学后的教室里回头。画面模仿当年电视播出的实际观感：整体偏软、对比略低、暗部糊成一片的胶片颗粒；横向的扫描线在画面上留下极淡的条纹。颜色用当年前后特有的偏黄绿白平衡，红色总往橘里偏。用少量网点纸过渡中间调，但保持两阶上色的基本结构。边缘带一点视频信号的水平位移重影，像是从录像带上截下来的一帧。构图取四分之三侧的中景。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: The 90s television look: slight fade and colour bleed from 16mm transferred to tape, soft vignette corners, and economical frame counts that read as movement.
styles.craftZh: 少女革命、EVA、美少女战士、口袋妖怪那个年代：16mm 胶转磁的轻微退色、柔和的暗角、为了省钱的低帧。怀旧杀器。

styles.desc: 手绘与数码混血的尴尬又迷人的阶段：人物还是赛璐璐，已经开始出现泛光效果与三维辅助背景/机甲，色彩饱和度偏高。
styles.note: 00 年代的「油光感」来自后期 bloom，别再加 film grain 抢戏
styles.demo: 1girl, 2000s anime style, digital composite, subtle bloom, glossy hair highlight, mid-frame studio lighting
styles.gpt: Early 2000s transitional anime still: a hero standing on the deck of a partly computer-generated battleship beneath an overcast sky. Mix the two technologies exactly as studios did then, character rendered with suspiciously uniform digital lineart and flat cel shading, matte-painted background carrying hybrid atmospheric effects, and a three-dimensional vehicle whose surface shading and lack of line quality read as visibly foreign next to the hand-drawn figure. Add the era's signature soft glow bloom across every highlight and mild edge aliasing where layers were composited. Compose as a 4:3 episode frame with restrained camera movement. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 2000 年代初期过渡期数码动画插画：一名少年在放学路上回头看镜头。画面处在从赛璐璐转向数码的混合期：主体还是硬边两阶上色，但背景已经开始用软过渡与明显的柔和高光，光照偏生硬的高位打光，阴影里出现生硬的第二色边缘。整体饱和度偏高、对比偏冲，皮肤泛出不自然的粉白。带一点早期的数码锐化感与压缩痕迹。构图取略仰的中景。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: The awkward and appealing hybrid period: characters still fully cel-shaded while bloom effects and three-dimensional assist backgrounds or mecha begin to appear, with saturation pushed high.
styles.craftZh: 手绘与数码混血的尴尬又迷人的阶段：人物还是赛璐璐，已经开始出现泛光效果与三维辅助背景/机甲，色彩饱和度偏高。

styles.desc: 1080p 制式普及后的标准样貌：线条极锐利、色彩明度高，阴影分层从一层增加为两层。绝大多数「看起来像新番」的图都属此类。
styles.note: 这是最安全不踩雷的基础层，先锁定它再加其他变量
styles.demo: 1girl, modern anime style, crisp digital lineart, two-layer cel shading, vibrant colors, clean composition
styles.gpt: Modern 2010s television anime frame: a school idol group mid-performance on a brightly lit stage with the audience dissolved into soft bokeh. Apply the clean contemporary pipeline, razor-sharp antialiased lineart, layered multi-step cel shading with a distinct second shadow and one small specular catchlight, highly saturated but carefully keyed color script, and background art that quietly borrows photographic depth cues without becoming a render. Keep the image absolutely clean with no grain, dirt or vector artifacts. Compose a crisp 16:9 frame with confident top stage lighting and legible crowd detail behind. No text, logos, watermarks or UI elements.
styles.gptZh: 2010 年代高清电视动画插画：一名少女站在黄昏的屋顶上看向远方。数码软阴影上色——多层渐变取代硬边分色，皮肤通透，头发上有一圈圈柔和的高光环，背景是真实的散景与空气感。光线有明显方向性，阴影柔和不死板，色彩清透但不过度饱和。整体达到商业动画的高完成度标准，细节丰富却不杂乱。构图取中远景，天空占画面上半部。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: The standard look after 1080p became the norm: extremely crisp linework, bright tonal range, and shadow separation expanded from one step to two. Most images that read as recent broadcast animation belong here.
styles.craftZh: 1080p 制式普及后的标准样貌：线条极锐利、色彩明度高，阴影分层从一层增加为两层。绝大多数「看起来像新番」的图都属此类。

styles.desc: 鬼灭之后一线电视动画的新标准：大量数码粒子、镜头光晕、复合半透明图层素材，画面接近 4K 演示片。
styles.note: 特效吃算力也吃模型，SD1.5 基本出不来，建议 SDXL / Flux / Illustrious 等新模型
styles.demo: swordsman mid-attack, high fidelity anime, particle effects, volumetric light rays, HDR highlights, digital composite
styles.gpt: 2020s high-fidelity anime effects frame built on layered digital compositing: a swordsman clashing mid-air with a spirit entity in a shattered shrine courtyard. Construct the shot from photoreal effects layers, volumetric god rays raking through slowly turning dust, floating ember particles each carrying its own motion blur trail, multi-element lens flare, HDR-like specular clipping along the blade edge, and subtle bloom wrapping every bright contour. Keep character lineart crisp while the effects occupy a separate photographic space, and preserve tertiary detail even deep in shadow. Compose a dynamic wide frame with implied camera shake energy. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 2020 年代高规格特效流动画插画：一名角色站在雨夜霓虹的巷子里。画面有现代顶级动画的规格：多层体积光穿过雨幕，湿地面反射精确到几乎对称，水珠与飞溅被逐颗刻画；色彩分级丰富，暗部保留冷色偏移、亮部保留暖色偏移，整体通透不发灰。加轻微镜头辉光与色差，不要过曝。构图用低机位仰视强化气势，前景有虚化元素做纵深。画面不要可读文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: The current top-tier television standard: heavy use of digital particles, lens bloom and layered translucent FX plates, at a level close to 4K demonstration footage.
styles.craftZh: 鬼灭之后一线电视动画的新标准：大量数码粒子、镜头光晕、复合半透明图层素材，画面接近 4K 演示片。

styles.desc: 故意做旧的播放介质损伤：磁迹失真、色度溢出、扫描线、底部跳动的噪声带。近年低保真与蒸汽波视觉的标配。
styles.note: 这是「画质负优化」词，一定要放在 prompt 靠后位置，别让它盖住画质词
styles.demo: anime screenshot of city street, VHS tracking error, chroma bleed, CRT scanlines, lo-fi, dated look, 1990s
styles.gpt: VHS analog tape capture aesthetic applied to an anime frame: an empty late-night city street seen through a worn consumer recording. Degrade it convincingly with heavy chroma bleed smearing color to the right of every bright edge, low-resolution luma softness, horizontal tracking distortion bands drifting across the lower third, occasional dropout flicker lines, and pronounced scanlining over the whole picture. Push the color toward bleeding magenta and crushed blacks with milky lifted shadows, then add faint curved CRT vignetting at the corners. Keep it authentically lo-fi rather than a clean modern digital filter. Include no readable text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 录像带 / 模拟磁带质感的动画画面：一名少年坐在老式电视机前。整幅模仿被反复翻录的 VHS 磁带：横向的跟踪噪声带、轻微的时基抖动、画面上下缘的色带溢出，整体饱和度被压得发闷、颜色往偏黄绿的方向漂。能看出磁带特有的软化与色彩溢出。构图把电视屏幕放在画面正中偏上，前景留一点房间的暗部。画面不要可读文字或字幕，也不要水印。
styles.craftEn: Analogue videotape rendering: chroma bleeding between channels, horizontal tracking noise drifting through the frame, banded luminance, mild vertical roll, and colour that sits noticeably duller than the source material.
styles.craftZh: 故意做旧的播放介质损伤：磁迹失真、色度溢出、扫描线、底部跳动的噪声带。近年低保真与蒸汽波视觉的标配。

styles.desc: 背景美术是最大招牌：厚涂水粉的云、草坡与天空，透视极大，人物小而环境大。人物线条简化，脸偏圆、配色温润。
styles.note: 重点是「背景压过角色」，写 wide shot, detailed background, character small in frame
styles.demo: girl flying over green hills, studio ghibli style, painterly sky with cumulus clouds, detailed background painting, wide shot, soft daylight
styles.tagsKw: painterly background art, lush green fields, soft pastoral light, hand-painted scenery, warm natural palette
styles.gpt: Hand-painted pastoral anime film still in the spirit of mid-career Ghibli: a girl pedaling down a narrow country lane through tall summer grass toward a distant farmhouse. Build the world almost entirely out of lovingly painted background art, dense layered greens with believable botanical variety rather than repeated textures, warm afternoon light diffusing through leaf canopies, and honest atmospheric perspective softening the hills behind. Keep the characters drawn simply, rounded forms and modest shading, so that they sit inside the world instead of on top of it, and let cloud shadows travel slowly across the fields. Compose a wide frame with the horizon placed high. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 温柔的田园水彩动画插画：一名穿连衣裙的小女孩站在夏日午后的草原上，远山与层叠的积云之间。技法是柔水彩铺陈——颜料在纸上晕开但边界保持柔和的整洁，颜色层叠而不浑浊，天空用留白与极淡的水洗做出云层的体积感。光线是全年最好的那种高角度暖光，投影短而软。草木的画法保留铅线的轻快与不完全规整，房屋的木结构用简练的线条交代。整体色调明亮、饱和度中等偏低，绿色偏黄而非偏蓝。构图取广角中景，人物在画面右侧三分之一处，大片草原留给视线。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Extremes of value contrast: near-black masses beside near-white, heavy black contour, sparse midtones, and deliberately awkward cropped framing. Figure drawing is loose and exaggerated.
styles.craftZh: 背景美术是最大招牌：厚涂水粉的云、草坡与天空，透视极大，人物小而环境大。人物线条简化，脸偏圆、配色温润。

styles.desc: 俗称「京都脸」：脸型圆润、眼睛水润高光丰富、头发柔顺分层，打光偏暖，整体有一种温吞、干净、日常呼吸感。
styles.note: 关键字是 delicate detailed eyes + soft blush，别用 hard shadows
styles.demo: 1girl, school hallway, kyoani style, soft round face, detailed glossy eyes, warm rim light, gentle blush, slice of life
styles.tagsKw: soft round face, delicate eyes, warm pastel lighting, subtle blush, clean friendly linework
styles.gpt: Kyoto Animation style anime frame: a high school girl glancing back to smile in a softly lit classroom just after rain. Deliver the studio's finish, rounded soft facial construction with small delicate eyes holding layered internal gradients and one sharp upper catchlight, pale warm blush brushed across the cheeks, hair drawn as flowing volumes each carrying several distinct reflection areas, and gentle pastel ambient light with generous bounce from the floor. Keep the background detailed yet slightly desaturated so characters remain the brightest thing on screen. Compose a calm chest-up shot with a slight charming tilt to the camera. Include no text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 清淡细腻的日常动画插画：一名女生坐在旧书店的木桌前翻书。整体是柔和的上色风格——皮肤用很轻的渐层，鼻尖和耳廓只有一点点红；眼睛画得大而干净，瞳孔里有明确的两点高光，但不像塑料那样过分通透。头发有成束的分层，不是散乱线条。布料的褶皱线浅而少，画面保持安静、不堆细节。光线是傍晚的斜射，窗棂在桌面投下一格一格的暖影。配色用米白、木色与一点靛蓝。构图取略俯的中近景。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Energetic painted backgrounds with strong perspective and extensive atmospheric perspective; figures stay comparatively simple and flat. Paint application is confident and loose, with visible warm and cool separation across the whole frame.
styles.craftZh: 俗称「京都脸」：脸型圆润、眼睛水润高光丰富、头发柔顺分层，打光偏暖，整体有一种温吞、干净、日常呼吸感。

styles.desc: 辨识度极高：倾斜镜头、夸张的线条构图、背景突然被压平成扁平贴纸、屏幕上糊满文字，常用单一高对比色（如《物语》系列的粉与黑）。
styles.note: 倾斜构图写 dutch angle / low angle extreme wide shot 触发最快
styles.demo: 1girl, shaft style head tilt, hard black shadows, flat pasted background, abstract shapes, high contrast pink and black
styles.tagsKw: flat pasted backgrounds, text-heavy screen layout, extreme wide shot, head tilt, surreal composition
styles.gpt: Shinbo and Shaft style anime composition: a girl waiting alone at a bus stop rendered with aggressive graphic staging. Push every house signal at once, an extreme wide shot under a severely distorted one-point perspective ceiling grid, figures placed flat against deliberately collaged backgrounds noticeably simpler than the characters, stray objects exiled to the frame edges, and a wide empty band of negative space left across the center where typography would normally sit. Keep the character drawing clean and finely lined. Let one highly saturated accent hue fight against an otherwise restrained scheme. Compose from an unnatural camera position with no interest in realism. No readable text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 实验性动画插画，带强烈的符号化视觉与轻微的故障感：一名少女站在黄昏的堤坝上。构图刻意偏心，主体压在画面一角，大片空景。画面里有几处不合理的元素并置——同一片天空出现两种不同的色温，接缝生硬。叠加极轻的扫描线、色彩通道错位与局部的像素化，让画面像一份信号不太干净的复制品。线条本身锐利、造型高度概括，几乎不做渐变。色彩用高对比的补色撞。整体诡异但不恐怖，有强烈的作者性。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Soft, atmospheric, low-contrast rendering with an abundance of blown highlights and a warm-to-cool gradient running through the whole frame. Emphasises mood and light over structural clarity.
styles.craftZh: 辨识度极高：倾斜镜头、夸张的线条构图、背景突然被压平成扁平贴纸、屏幕上糊满文字，常用单一高对比色（如《物语》系列的粉与黑）。

styles.desc: 底色压暗，靠高质量数码光效提亮：爆炸火花、水/呼吸特效、镜头炫光。鬼灭之刃是其视觉代表。
styles.note: 「暗底 + 亮特效」是它的底层公式，务必压暗整体曝光
styles.demo: demon slayer style, katana slash with water breath effect, ufotable, volumetric light, dark palette with cyan flames, digital effects
styles.tagsKw: digital effects, volumetric light shafts, blooming gradients, dark base with neon accents
styles.gpt: Ufotable style anime effects frame: a swordsman mid-strike in a night forest with the blade trailing elemental energy. Construct the signature look, a deep near-black base palette so that highlights alone carry the image, one strong key light rimming the silhouette out of the darkness, then heavy digital effects work layered on top, volumetric mist drifting between the trunks, ember particles each with individual motion blur, bleeding gradient flares, and subtle chromatic dispersion along the edges of released energy. Keep character lineart thin and crisp against soft bokeh foliage. Compose a wide shot from a low tilted camera. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 以现代特效质感为主的动画插画：一名角色在雨中拔刀，动作停在最激烈的一瞬。画面强调速度与冲击——放射状的集中线、飞溅的水珠逐颗刻画、刀锋周围一圈极亮的边缘光。特效的绘制逻辑是「可读性优先」：即使信息量极大，主体轮廓依然一眼可辨。用高对比的暗背景衬托明亮的主体，色彩分级偏冷蓝与暖橙的对撞。构图用极端的低角度与广角透视强化冲击力。整体华丽、锋利、密度极高。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Dense fine linework carrying most of the description, with narrow tonal range and an understated background. Detail is uniform across the frame rather than concentrated on the subject.
styles.craftZh: 底色压暗，靠高质量数码光效提亮：爆炸火花、水/呼吸特效、镜头炫光。鬼灭之刃是其视觉代表。

styles.desc: 粗线 + 极端透视 + 有限高饱和配色，画面冲击力优先。天元突破、斩服少女、赛博朋克边缘行者。
styles.note: 夸张透视用 extreme perspective / fisheye foreground 强化
styles.demo: cyberpunk girl with giant scissors, studio trigger style, bold thick outlines, extreme perspective, purple and yellow palette, dynamic angle
styles.tagsKw: bold thick lines, exaggerated perspective, high contrast, limited color palette, dynamic pose
styles.gpt: Studio Trigger style anime frame: a wild-haired fighter bracing against a shockwave of debris in a ruined arena. Draw it with the studio's aggressive hand, very thick confidently tapered outlines, exaggerated wide-angle perspective that stretches the limbs toward the frame edge, extreme high-contrast lighting resolving into solid black shadow masses, and a deliberately limited flat palette of no more than four hues. Carry the motion past the point of physical plausibility, and substitute rough poster-like background shapes for actual scenery. Compose diagonally with violent foreshortening and loose micron pen hatching in the darks. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 高速动作动画插画，线条凌厉、色块撞色：两名角色在都市屋顶对峙。造型语言是硬朗的几何化——尖锐的轮廓、大块的纯色、几乎没有中间调。画面里大量使用斜切构图与极端的仰俯角，配合放射状集中线与硬边的速度线。上色是硬边两阶加第三阶的有限中间调，颜色用高饱和的撞色，界限清晰不混。背景简化为几何色块与网格，不画细节。整个画面读起来是「快、吵、硬」。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Rounded, simplified figure construction with large heads and simplified limbs, paired with bright high-key colour and decorative pattern filling empty space.
styles.craftZh: 粗线 + 极端透视 + 有限高饱和配色，画面冲击力优先。天元突破、斩服少女、赛博朋克边缘行者。

styles.desc: 人与机械都做得漂亮的那一类：《钢之炼金术师》《我的英雄学院》《交响诗篇》。特点是动作原画张数多、机体设计硬朗干净。
styles.note: 偏硬派，少软萌少厚涂，走 clean shape + strong silhouette 路线
styles.demo: hero mid-punch, industrial city, studio bones style, crisp action lines, fluid motion blur, clean mechanical background
styles.tagsKw: clean mechanical design, fluid animation frames, balanced lighting, crisp action lines
styles.gpt: Studio BONES style anime frame: a ragtag crew walking down a sunlit steampunk market street. Balance their trademark qualities, clean industrial design showing believable mechanical joinery on every prop and vehicle, character poses drawn by animators who understand real weight transfer, even daylight lighting that refuses heavy stylization, and crisp action lines used sparingly rather than decoratively. Keep the palette friendly mid-saturation with sky blue and warm brick accents, and let the background follow real architectural logic down to load-bearing structure. Compose an inviting group shot cropped at the thigh with clear depth separation. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 都市写实动画插画，人物与场景同等重要：一名成年男性站在傍晚的公寓天台上，远处的城市灯火在背景里铺开。人物处理克制——五官不夸张，肌肉与关节有可信的结构，皮肤有真实的明暗过渡而非平涂。背景是完整绘制的实景：窗框、电线、空调外机、远处的建筑轮廓都画出来并带透视收敛。整体色调偏冷灰，光源来自城市灯火的综合散射光，人物脸上没有明确主光。构图取中景，城市灯火填满背景。整体写实、克制、有生活质感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: A flat, poster-like finish with strong geometric blocking, bold areas of unmodulated colour, and asymmetry used deliberately. Illustration reads as designed layout rather than as a depicted space.
styles.craftZh: 人与机械都做得漂亮的那一类：《钢之炼金术师》《我的英雄学院》《交响诗篇》。特点是动作原画张数多、机体设计硬朗干净。

styles.desc: 今敏一脉：高度写实的都市细节、镜子与屏风式的构图、现实与幻想的边界不断溶解。背景信息密度极高。
styles.note: 加了 cinematic realism 后模型会往真人跑，务必保留 anime style 把画风拉回来
styles.demo: urban apartment at dusk, madhouse style, highly detailed realistic background, cinematic framing, tilted composition, muted colors
styles.tagsKw: cinematic realism, psychological framing, detailed urban background, measured camera
styles.gpt: Madhouse realist anime still in the vein of Kon's psychological cinema: a woman standing in a narrow Tokyo hallway whose mirrors disagree with her. Apply cinematic live-action discipline, accurate lens perspective, plausible interior architecture cluttered with accumulated daily objects, muted naturalistic color, and faces drawn without idealized contours or smoothing. Stage depth so foreground furniture intrudes past the focal plane, and let every highlight come from an identifiable practical source inside the building. Compose slightly off-center with a framing that quietly implies unease rather than announcing it through distortion. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 写实取向的动画电影插画：一名中年女性站在老公寓的走廊尽头。整幅接近实拍质感——皮肤有毛孔与油光，手指结构准确，头发是一根根画出来的发丝而不是色块，衣物能看到织物的厚度与磨损。光线只有一个来源并在脸上投出明确的明暗分界，暗部保留细节而不是压成黑。用长焦压缩空间，走廊的透视线在背景里收得很浅。色彩低饱和，接近胶片的响应。整体沉静、有年代感、有生活的重量。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Heavy black outlines, flat fills, and a deliberately narrow, slightly desaturated palette. Faces stay simple and largely expressionless, with emotion carried by composition and colour alone.
styles.craftZh: 今敏一脉：高度写实的都市细节、镜子与屏风式的构图、现实与幻想的边界不断溶解。背景信息密度极高。

styles.desc: 《进击的巨人》终章、《咒术回战》、《电锯人》：大面积黑影、粗颗粒噪点、崩坏的废墟场景，物体解剖感强，整体氛围压抑。
styles.note: 关键在于 heavy grain + low key lighting，画面要敢黑下去
styles.demo: battle in ruined city, dark cinematic tones, heavy grain, low key lighting, gritty texture, dramatic rim light, detailed destruction
styles.tagsKw: dark cinematic tones, heavy grain, gritty texture, dramatic lighting, deep blacks
styles.gpt: MAPPA and WIT style dark cinematic anime still: a scarred soldier standing in the aftermath of a night battle in a ruined cathedral town. Keep it gritty and desaturated with heavy organic film grain, a muddy earth palette broken only by cold moonlight, hard single-source falloff letting detail die honestly in shadow, and volumes carved by atmosphere rather than decorative linework. Render anatomy showing strain, exhaustion and weight gain from exertion, and keep architecture heavy, weathered and physically believable with real rubble logic. Compose a cinemascope frame with the figure deliberately small in it. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 现代暗调动画插画，色彩高级而压低：两名角色在一间昏暗的房间里对峙。整幅的色彩分级是重点——压低饱和度、偏移暗部到冷蓝绿、高光收成一点暖橙，形成明确的冷暖分离。打光用极少的几个强源，人物半张脸沉在暗里，只靠眼神光与轮廓光勾出形体。构图大量使用大面积暗部与负空间，主体占画面比例小。摄影角度偏门框与遮挡物，形成偷看式的构图。画面有胶片颗粒与轻微的镜头光晕。整体高级、紧绷、有作者表达的片子感。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Dense tonal realism: full gradation, material rendering with distinct surface qualities, and lighting consistent with a real environment. Backgrounds are fully painted rather than suggested.
styles.craftZh: 《进击的巨人》终章、《咒术回战》、《电锯人》：大面积黑影、粗颗粒噪点、崩坏的废墟场景，物体解剖感强，整体氛围压抑。

styles.desc: 荒木线：极粗的墨线、眉骨高耸、鼻影浓重、肌肉线条强调到失真，姿势极度戏剧化，配色大胆跳脱。
styles.note: 别写实，要写 exaggerated muscular anatomy — 失真正是风格本体
styles.demo: standing man in dramatic pose, jojo bizarre adventure style, araki hirohiko, heavy black shadows, thick ink lines, gold ornament
styles.tagsKw: heavy black shadows, thick ink lines, exaggerated muscular anatomy, gold accents, graphic pose
styles.gpt: David Production anime portrait in the vein of Araki's graphic rules: a flamboyant stand user posing against a striped gradient sky. Translate the manga's line logic into animation, enormously thick tapered ink contours, heavy areas of solid black shadow holding absolutely no gradation, exaggerated muscular anatomy rendered as sculpted idealized planes, dense patterned clothing detail, and gold accents throwing sharp specular highlights. Choose a poster-like highly saturated scheme with deliberately unusual pairings, then add gradients and star-shaped sparkles placed for decoration rather than realism. Compose a dramatic low-angle three-quarter portrait. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 极具装饰性的高对比动画插画：一名少年摆出夸张的姿态，背景是放射状的速度线与几何图案。造型语言走极端——肌肉与服饰的装饰细节密集到近乎繁复，形态夸张到几乎是漫画式的符号。配色极度张扬：高饱和的红、黄、青三色直接撞在一起，黑线粗重。构图充满斜切与极端的角度，画面信息量很大但层次分明——人物压前景、图案退背景。整体是纯粹的视觉冲击，不追求写实。画面不要可读文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Diagonal-dominant composition, extreme perspective, and speed expressed through smear frames and repeated forms. Cool, high-contrast palette with a metallic sheen on mechanical surfaces.
styles.craftZh: 荒木线：极粗的墨线、眉骨高耸、鼻影浓重、肌肉线条强调到失真，姿势极度戏剧化，配色大胆跳脱。

styles.desc: 线条像橡胶一样自由扭曲，背景常被抽象色块或条纹图案替代，人物可以随时形变。最不「工业化」的一支。
styles.note: 越失控越对：不要加 clean lines / correct proportions
styles.demo: two characters floating in abstract space, science saru style, loose wobbly lines, flat bold color blocks, psychedelic patterns
styles.tagsKw: loose rubber-hose lines, abstract color blocks, fluid morphing shapes, limited rigid perspective
styles.gpt: Science SARU style anime frame in the vein of Yuasa: a girl whose body stretches and liquefies mid-dance through an abstract city. Prioritize expressive distortion over consistency, loose rubber-hose limbs bending with no internal joints, forms morphing continuously between recognizable states within a single pose, flat abstract color blocks standing in for scenery, and a rigid paper-doll perspective that refuses to open up into depth. Keep the line quality deliberately wobbly and hand-drawn, and allow crude unfinished areas to sit next to highly rendered ones in the same frame. Compose with no stable horizon. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 自由狂放的实验动画插画：一名少年在雨中奔跑，画面被切成几个错位的时间片段。造型极度简化又极度夸张——身体可以拉长压扁，关节弯折的角度不合常理，姿态像在用整个身体说话。颜色用大面积的脏橘与暗青撞在一起，饱和度高但整体压暗。上色故意粗糙，能看到笔触与未完成的色块，画面像被反复擦改过。构图不稳定，视角倾斜，节奏碎。整体癫狂、有生命力、手工感强。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Rounded forms with soft gradient shading and a bright, high-key palette; composition stays simple and centred. A clean commercial clarity well separated from painterly approaches.
styles.craftZh: 线条像橡胶一样自由扭曲，背景常被抽象色块或条纹图案替代，人物可以随时形变。最不「工业化」的一支。

styles.desc: 攻壳机动队、机动警察：冷色调、低饱和、大量建筑与器械硬表面细节，氛围沉静理性，几乎没有可爱元素。
styles.note: 走真实建筑比例，少曲线，多直线与对称构图
styles.demo: cybernetic operative in rain, production i.g style, cold desaturated palette, highly detailed urban architecture, symmetrical composition
styles.tagsKw: cold realism, muted desaturated palette, architectural detail, political sci-fi, precise line work
styles.gpt: Production I.G realist anime still in the vein of Oshii: a patrol walking beneath a brutalist concrete arcade at dawn. Lock the palette cold and desaturated, slate gray, concrete blue and one faint industrial accent, then render architectural detail obsessively so that every pipe run, expansion joint, service hatch and vertical water stain is accounted for. Light everything with flat diffuse overcast so no surface becomes flattering, and give the figures believable weight, stiff uniforms and tired posture. Compose as a static wide surveillance-style shot holding deep focus front to back. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 静态构图、摄影机意识强烈的动画插画：一名女子站在雨后的街道上，画面几乎全静止。构图极其讲究——水平线位置精确，人物压在画面的三分点，建筑的垂直线形成画框。色调极低饱和，接近单色；光线是阴天散射光，没有明确投影。画面里大量出现「日常观察」的细节：湿地面、空调外机、便利店招牌的模糊光块，但都不抢主体。上色用两阶赛璐璐加极少的中间调。整体冷静、克制、有距离感，像用镜头而不是用笔画的。画面不要可读文字或字母，招牌只保留模糊光块，不要水印。
styles.craftEn: Distinctive silhouette-first design, exaggerated proportion, and small separated highlight masses. Figures read clearly even at thumbnail scale, with decorative costume detail layered on top.
styles.craftZh: 攻壳机动队、机动警察：冷色调、低饱和、大量建筑与器械硬表面细节，氛围沉静理性，几乎没有可爱元素。

styles.desc: 高达一脉的「写实机器人」：外装甲分块、铆钉/管路等硬表面细节、军绿/沙黄低调配色，机器人当作重工业产品来设计。
styles.note: 强化 hard surface modeling / mechanical panel lines，别把它画成圆润的卡通机器人
styles.demo: real robot in hangar, hard surface mechanical design, military olive palette, detailed panel lines, industrial lighting, wide shot
styles.tagsKw: hard surface mecha design, military color palette, mechanical detail, real-robot proportion
styles.gpt: Sunrise real-robot mecha still: a production-model mobile suit standing guard on a desert landing field under hazy midday heat. Design it as hardware first, believable hard-surface paneling with deliberate gaps and fastener rows, hydraulic joints, exposed actuators, ammunition feeds, and matte military plating in olive and slate with no glowing hero lines. Add realistic battle damage, chipped paint along the leading edges and dried hydraulic fluid staining below the joints. Render the machine with heterogeneous component density rather than smooth organic surfaces, and let dust haze flatten the rear ranks. Compose a documentary three-quarter shot at true eye level. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 机甲动画插画，机械设定密度高：一台人形机甲站在黄昏的发射场。机械造型强调结构可信度——每一块装甲板有明确的关节与转轴连接，可见液压杆、线束与铆钉，比例接近真实的机械工程逻辑。表面材质分三档：哑光涂层、金属高光、橡胶关节。上色是硬边两阶加网点纸的中间调，配色以纯白、深灰与警示橙为主。构图取略仰的全景，把机甲放在场地中央并让人物的渺小入画以显尺度。整体硬朗、机械感强、有重量。画面不要文字、编号、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: A cool, restrained palette with a dominant single hue, low overall saturation, and long soft shadows. Sparse composition that leaves large empty regions.
styles.craftZh: 高达一脉的「写实机器人」：外装甲分块、铆钉/管路等硬表面细节、军绿/沙黄低调配色，机器人当作重工业产品来设计。

styles.desc: 轻小说改编的标准工业脸：角色美型度高、头发多层高光与分缕处理、制服笔挺、配色商业且讨喜。《刀剑神域》《辉夜大小姐》《更衣人偶》属此类。
styles.note: 这一流派最接近 MJ niji 的默认外观，想反其道而行时要明确加别的风格层
styles.demo: 1girl, high school uniform, cloverworks style, glossy hair strands, sharp detailed eyes, bokeh cafe background, bright commercial palette
styles.tagsKw: modern light novel look, glossy hair, sharp eyes, clean commercial polish, high-key lighting
styles.gpt: A-1 Pictures and CloverWorks style modern light-novel anime still: a glossy-haired heroine pausing in a sunlit hallway between classes. Deliver their specific polish, razor-thin even-weight lineart, sharp crystalline eyes built from several crisp highlight shapes with cool shadow beneath the iris, hair drawn strand by strand so that each lock carries its own reflective sweep, and a clean high-key commercial palette with restrained bloom. Reduce the background to soft-focus bokeh so the character reads instantly, and add precise uniform detailing and accessory proportions. Compose a chest-up portrait with gentle direct eye contact. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 轻小说 / 校园题材动画插画，画面精致讨喜：一名女学生站在社团活动室里。角色设定是高完成度的偶像化——脸小、五官清秀、眼睛大而有层次，皮肤用柔和渐层加一点通透感。头发做成有光泽的成束发块，每一束都有自己的高光。服装细节丰富，配色统一在一套协调的色盘内（藏蓝、米白、一点粉）。光线是明亮柔和的室内光，投影很淡。背景画得干净但有生活细节：桌上有社团道具、窗边有绿植。整体好看、精致、没有攻击性。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Painterly backgrounds carrying elaborate real-world detail while figures stay comparatively flat and untextured, producing deliberate contrast between figure and ground.
styles.craftZh: 轻小说改编的标准工业脸：角色美型度高、头发多层高光与分缕处理、制服笔挺、配色商业且讨喜。《刀剑神域》《辉夜大小姐》《更衣人偶》属此类。

styles.desc: 以 3D 背景 + 2D 人物的融合著称（漂流家园、想哭的我），背景透视精确、光源统一，人物带有轻微 CG 照明过渡。
styles.note: 关键是统一人物与背景的光源方向：写 consistent light direction 能显著减少违和
styles.demo: two kids on rooftop at sunset, studio colorido style, 3D rendered background integration, warm golden light, soft shadows, wide city view
styles.tagsKw: 3DCG background integration, soft realistic lighting, warm everyday tones, depth of field
styles.gpt: Studio Colorido style anime still with integrated three-dimensional backgrounds: two students eating lunch on a wooden veranda above a sunlit town. Blend hand-drawn characters into dimensionally correct rendered environments, true camera volume and believable light falloff, soft indirect bounce off the floorboards onto the figures, and photographic depth of field separating them from a convincingly real town below. Keep the character rendering soft and warm, matching its highlight direction exactly to the rendered light so nothing floats. Compose the whole frame around warm everyday domestic tone and modest exposure. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 三维与二维融合的动画插画：一名女孩站在飘着光斑的庭院里。角色本身是三维渲染质感——真实的体积光、皮肤与布料有物理正确的次表面散射，头发有一根根的独立发丝；但面部与身体的轮廓上叠了一层二维的手绘描边，线条有手绘的起伏。背景是纯二维绘制的平面色块与光斑，与角色形成明确的层次差。景深做得很浅，焦点只在眼睛。色调统一在暖白与浅蓝里，光斑是唯一的高亮点。整体柔和、干净、有技术炫技感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Smooth, glossy, high-finish rendering with a bright palette, evenly distributed light, and a strong central axis. Everything is lit clearly; nothing falls into deep shadow.
styles.craftZh: 以 3D 背景 + 2D 人物的融合著称（漂流家园、想哭的我），背景透视精确、光源统一，人物带有轻微 CG 照明过渡。

styles.desc: 近年国产二维（《大理寺日志》《雾山五行》《天官赐福》）分两条路：偏厚涂的华丽装饰路线，与偏传统线描的水墨线条路线。整体比日式更强调装饰性与东方符号。
styles.note: 别写成 Japanese anime，国风要用 chinese traditional costume + ink-influenced lines
styles.demo: tang dynasty street scene, chinese 2d animation style, elegant flowing robes, warm lantern light, detailed architecture, eastern palette
styles.gpt: Chinese two-dimensional donghua illustration: a young cultivator standing on a floating cloud-sea peak with ribbon streamers trailing through the air. Combine the regional hallmarks, extremely fine calligraphic linework that tapers like brush writing, a cool celadon and vermilion scheme lifted by gold ink accents, costume built from layered silk with embroidered cloud-pattern trim, and scenery drawn from stylized Chinese landscape painting rather than photographic reference. Render drifting petals and released spiritual energy as ribbon-like strokes with meaningful negative space between them. Compose a vertical full-body key visual leaving generous open sky above. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 国产二维动画插画：一名古装少年站在山门石阶上，远处是层叠的云海与松林。上色以平涂为主，边缘用清晰的深色描边，颜色偏饱和但压着一层灰，不通透也不刺眼。山水与建筑大量使用工笔线条的细节——瓦片、栏杆、衣纹都有交代；人物处理比影视作品更平面化，强调轮廓而非体积。加入轻量的水墨晕染做远景过渡，构图讲究对称与层次。色彩偏青绿与赭黄的传统配色。整体规整、有装饰性、色彩浓郁。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Ornate, high-density decorative treatment with abundant pattern and gilt-toned highlights, reflecting mid-Heian court painting conventions.
styles.craftZh: 近年国产二维（《大理寺日志》《雾山五行》《天官赐福》）分两条路：偏厚涂的华丽装饰路线，与偏传统线描的水墨线条路线。整体比日式更强调装饰性与东方符号。

styles.desc: 《凡人修仙传》《灵笼》《吞噬星空》等：UE 渲染的角色与场景，材质偏真实（布料/金属/皮肤次表面散射），近年来反而成为一种独有的国潮视觉。
styles.note: 这是唯一可以直接写 3d render, unreal engine 5 的动漫流派
styles.demo: xianxia cultivator on mountain peak, 3d chinese animation, unreal engine render, flowing hanfu with silk material, dramatic clouds, volumetric light
styles.gpt: Chinese three-dimensional CG donghua production frame: an armored cultivator facing a spirit beast atop a stone platform in storm light. Render it as high-end semi-realistic cinematic work, clean subsurface-scattered skin with visible pore detail, physically based fabric showing sheen on embroidered silk brocade, groomed hair with individual strand highlights catching the lightning, and heavy volumetric storm lighting with shafts through cloud. Keep the faces stylized toward anime ideals while the world around them stays photographic, and add layered particle dust and drifting mist elements. Compose an epic wide frame with the camera orbiting low and slow. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 国产三维动画电影质感插画：一名角色站在云海之上的山巅。渲染走偏写实的路线——皮肤有次表面散射，毛发有独立的发丝与毛发系统，服装布料有织物的纹理与垂坠。光线是全局光照驱动的，日出方向的暖光与天穹的冷蓝形成明确的冷暖分界，体积雾在山脊之间堆积。造型设计偏东方审美：身形修长、衣袖飘举。构图取广角全景，人物在画面中占比小以显环境。整体明亮、通透、有电影级完成度。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Monumental, precisely constructed forms with disciplined colour and hard edges, following Northern Renaissance panel conventions.
styles.craftZh: 《凡人修仙传》《灵笼》《吞噬星空》等：UE 渲染的角色与场景，材质偏真实（布料/金属/皮肤次表面散射），近年来反而成为一种独有的国潮视觉。

styles.desc: 探险活宝、宇宙小子、夏令营岛屿：橡皮管四肢、粗均匀描线、极高饱和平涂，表演夸张不受物理约束。
styles.note: 与日式的区别在于「简化的几何造型」，别加 anime details
styles.demo: two cartoon kids in forest, western cartoon style, rubber hose arms, thick outlines, flat bright colors, comedic expression
styles.gpt: Western animated cartoon still in the Cartoon Network tradition: a scrappy kid with an oversized head sprinting through a junkyard in panic. Hold to the old rules, rubber-hose limbs bending through smooth continuous arcs with no elbow or knee joint ever drawn, four-fingered hands inside thick white gloves, a very heavy uniform black outline, and completely flat unmottled color with no rendering or gradient anywhere. Push the pose to cartoon extremes with squash and stretch baked into a single frame, and keep the background as simple abstract geometric shapes in a complementary scheme. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 美式卡通动画插画，造型极度简化的成人向喜剧风格：一名身材高瘦的男子站在汽车旅馆门口。造型是招牌式的极简——眼睛是两个大黑点、没有鼻子、手是四根手指的白色手套、四肢细长成弹簧状。线条粗黑且轮廓统一，每个角色的体态差异承担全部性格塑造。上色用平涂加一层柔和的阴影色，颜色饱和度高、跳跃感强。场景绘制得比角色更细致，制造出一种「认真画的背景配荒诞角色」的错位幽默。构图留出大片空白让动作有余地。整体明亮、夸张、节奏轻快。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: A palette of damp earth colours and mossy greens with low-key interior illumination, following late-medieval panel conventions.
styles.craftZh: 探险活宝、宇宙小子、夏令营岛屿：橡皮管四肢、粗均匀描线、极高饱和平涂，表演夸张不受物理约束。

styles.desc: 小美人鱼到狮子王再到魔发奇缘：五官比例偏古典、轮廓清晰、背景自带故事书插画的绘画感，整体比日式更「舞台化处理」。
styles.note: 写 storybook illustration / theatrical lighting 比重 copy IP 名更容易出味
styles.demo: princess on castle balcony, disney renaissance style, hand-drawn animation, elegant proportions, storybook background, warm golden hour
styles.gpt: Disney Renaissance theatrical animation still: a young heroine singing alone on a castle balcony at first light. Render it with classical hand-drawn discipline, clean tapered line of varying weight, soft modeled color so that characters hold believable internal form and volume instead of flat cels, background painted as a genuine storybook watercolor environment with real atmospheric depth, and dramatic three-point theatrical lighting throwing a warm key from one side. Integrate light so the figure belongs to the painted world, and imply breath and impending movement through loose cloth. Compose like a filmed stage tableau. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 经典手绘动画复兴期的动画插画，戏剧化的舞台感：一名王子站在城堡的高塔上，远处是黄昏的天际线。构图是精心设计的舞台式布景——明确的舞台平面、精心安排的剪影层次、夸张的透视。色彩是厚涂式的绘画感：颜料有明显的堆叠与笔触，颜色之间有过渡而不是硬边，戏剧性强。角色造型带着九十年代手绘动画的优雅夸张比例，配色饱和浓郁。灯光从画面一侧斜切，制造戏剧性的强对比。整体华丽、有舞台感、有戏剧张力。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: A soft, grainy charcoal-and-chalk rendering with compressed midtones and visible tooth of the paper, following Rococo pastel conventions.
styles.craftZh: 小美人鱼到狮子王再到魔发奇缘：五官比例偏古典、轮廓清晰、背景自带故事书插画的绘画感，整体比日式更「舞台化处理」。

styles.zh: 成人动画 / Adult Swim 系
styles.desc: 刻意粗糙的线、病态低饱和配色、人物比例尴尬但又自洽。《瑞克和莫蒂》《太空终界》这条线，反讽感恰恰来自「画得不精致」。
styles.note: 别写 high quality / masterpiece — 精致度会毁掉这个流派的调性
styles.demo: two scientists in garage, adult swim animation style, crude loose lineart, muted sickly green palette, flat backgrounds, awkward proportions
styles.gpt: Adult Swim style late-night animation still: two exhausted roommates arguing unglamorously in a cluttered kitchen. Use deliberately crude construction, thin scratchy uneven lineart, awkward proportional choices such as narrow chests and stiff pipe-cleaner limbs, faces reduced to minimal dots and flat deadpan expressions, and a sickly muted scheme of olive, mustard and gray-brown that refuses to flatter anyone in frame. Keep the background sparse but grimy with visible ink bleed and slight registration wobble implying a rushed schedule. Compose a flat frontal two-shot with deadpan staging and no visual relief. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 成人向深夜动画插画，疏离怪诞的气质：一名西装男子站在一间空荡的便利店内。画面刻意保持静止与尴尬——没有人与人之间的互动，构图正对镜头，人物姿势略微不自然。造型是简化的、略带恐怖谷的写实：比例正常但表情刻画过少，形成一种「在场却疏离」的效果。环境细节莫名其妙地多：货架排列过于整齐、时钟停在同一个时间、走廊没有出口。色调偏灰绿，饱和度低，光线平淡无特色。整体压抑、静默、有黑色幽默。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Precisionist clarity with luminous colour, immaculate surface finish and hard-edged industrial geometry, following American illustration of the machine age.
styles.craftZh: 刻意粗糙的线、病态低饱和配色、人物比例尴尬但又自洽。《瑞克和莫蒂》《太空终界》这条线，反讽感恰恰来自「画得不精致」。

styles.zh: 蜘蛛侠平行宇宙（2D+3D 混合）
styles.desc: 把漫画网点、手绘轮廓、故障效果、亮色分层直接贴到三维渲染的角色上，形成强烈的「会动的漫画」效果。近年最被模仿的技术流派。
styles.note: 核心三个词：halftone dots + ink outlines on 3d render + chromatic aberration
styles.demo: superhero swinging between buildings, spider-verse style, halftone dots overlay, 3d render with ink outlines, pop colors, chromatic aberration
styles.gpt: Spider-Verse style hybrid two-dimensional and three-dimensional comic frame: a masked hero swinging through a candy-colored skyline. Combine the mediums explicitly rather than hiding the seam, a cel-shaded three-dimensional body offset deliberately out of registration against its own hand-drawn ink outline, printed halftone dot patterns laid across the shading like cheap comic coloring, drawn speed-line streaks and cloud shapes pasted into dimensional space, and a bold pop scheme clashing magenta directly against cyan. Add heavy motion smear and frame-stepping so it reads as animation rather than illustration. Compose with aggressive perspective. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 二维与三维融合的动画插画：一名角色从地铁车厢冲出的瞬间。二维部分负责角色——手绘的轮廓线、夸张的形变与表情，色彩用平涂加网点纸的硬边赛璐璐，姿态大幅拉伸变形。三维部分负责城市——完整的透视街道、真实的材质与光照、景深与镜头畸变都能看出来。两者的分工要清晰可见：三维的城市完全按真实透视绘制，二维的角色明显与之不在同一空间逻辑里。这种刻意的错位就是风格所在。色彩高饱和，动态强。画面不要可读文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Mural-scale composition with monumental figures, layered spatial recession and a warm, chalky pigment palette.
styles.craftZh: 把漫画网点、手绘轮廓、故障效果、亮色分层直接贴到三维渲染的角色上，形成强烈的「会动的漫画」效果。近年最被模仿的技术流派。

styles.desc: 竖屏条漫进化出的画法：服装与时髦道具极度精细、发丝飘逸分层、眼妆与高光明暗对比强烈，整体偏时尚画报审美。
styles.note: 服装细节是关键特征，写 elaborate fashionable outfit 比单纯堆画质词更有效
styles.demo: 1girl in modern fantasy outfit, manhwa style, ultra-detailed eyes, glossy layered hair, soft airbrush skin, fashionable accessories
styles.gpt: Korean webtoon and manhwa style vertical composition: a fashionable office worker crossing a lit crosswalk at night, built for phone scrolling. Apply the finish accurately, heavily airbrushed soft shading with almost no hard edge anywhere on the body, extremely detailed eyes rendered with dozens of highlight shapes and concentric iris rings, flawless skin with blushed cheeks and a defined cupid's bow, contemporary fashion drawn down to individual fabric textures, and background elements simplified or dissolved into gradient fog. Keep everything tall and centered so no important shape touches the side margins. Compose a full-body vertical. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 竖版条漫画分格插画：一名学生站在教学楼的天台上，画面是手机竖屏阅读的纵向长条。分格方式符合条漫节奏——大量竖长条的分格，格与格之间留很窄的缝，靠阅读顺序推进而不是靠画面的空间关系。线稿风格接近美式漫画：粗黑轮廓、大量交叉排线与黑白网点，气泡与旁白框占据相当比例。人物造型时尚化、表情夸张、发型细节丰富。色调以黑白为主，仅在强调处用少量网点或淡色。整体节奏快、有网漫特有的紧张感。文字框留空，不要写出文字。画面不要水印。
styles.craftEn: Ukiyo-e conventions: flat colour areas, heavy contour, asymmetry, and a low diagonal viewpoint that subordinates the figure to the space.
styles.craftZh: 竖屏条漫进化出的画法：服装与时髦道具极度精细、发丝飘逸分层、眼妆与高光明暗对比强烈，整体偏时尚画报审美。

styles.desc: 为 Live2D 而生的设计：正面构图居多、配饰与记忆点强烈、配色鲜明、背景干净或纯透明。强调「剪影一眼可辨」。
styles.note: 透明背景用途下写 simple background, white background，便于后期抠图
styles.demo: vtuber original character, front facing, distinctive hair ornament, high contrast color scheme, clean simple background, live2d ready
styles.gpt: VTuber Live2D character key art: a brightly designed virtual streamer waving at the viewer in an open frontal pose. Build her for appeal at thumbnail size, a highly saturated coordinated scheme using two dominant hues plus white and one accent, layered accessories such as asymmetric hair ornaments, a headset, and clothing panels carrying subtle tech motifs, large expressive eyes with multiple sparkle highlights, and clean even linework free of rendering noise. Keep the gesture open and frontal so the silhouette reads immediately, and set her against a simple soft gradient or patterned circle. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 虚拟主播角色立绘：一名叫「星」的虚拟主播形象。角色设计要能当商品卖——造型有明确的主题概念（星际 + 猫耳），配色只有两到三个主色加配饰色，识别点在发型轮廓与耳饰。立绘是完整的三视图倾向构图：正面全身占主要位置，旁边放一到两个小尺寸的表情与细节特写。画法是干净的二次元赛璐璐加柔和渐变，皮肤质感通透，眼睛的高光明确。配饰与服装细节精致但克制。背景保持极简的纯色加少量几何元素，不要抢主体。整体完成度高、适合作为商品图。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Restrained two-ink construction with generous reserved white, a limited pigment range, and a matte, non-reflective surface.
styles.craftZh: 为 Live2D 而生的设计：正面构图居多、配饰与记忆点强烈、配色鲜明、背景干净或纯透明。强调「剪影一眼可辨」。

styles.desc: 骗 AI 交出「官方截图」的关键层：一层薄胶片颗粒 + 广播级的轻微压缩感，能立刻让画面脱离 AI 插画的长相。
styles.note: 几乎所有怀旧向图的收尾都建议加它；但要放在发光/特效词之后
styles.demo: school classroom afternoon, anime screencap, anime cel, soft morning light, slight film grain, cinematic composition
styles.gpt: Anime screencap simulation: a quiet moment of a girl sliding open a classroom window, rendered as though lifted straight off a broadcast episode. Reproduce broadcast reality faithfully, correct television aspect rather than print proportions, very slight interlace grain, mild chroma softness typical of analog-to-digital transfer, and compression-friendly flat color decisions with no illustrative embellishment added by an artist. Keep the composition functional and unremarkable like a real cut, characters placed off-center, props clipped at the frame edges, and no hero lighting or rim light anywhere. Add faint corner darkening from old broadcast matting. Include no subtitles, logos, watermarks or UI.
styles.gptZh: 动画截图感的模拟：一名角色在雨中撑伞，站在一条两侧有树的街道上。整幅要像从动画正片里截取的一帧——有片源特有的柔和高光、轻微的数码压缩痕迹与极淡的扫描线；颜色分级经过调校，暗部偏青、亮部偏暖。构图是标准的动画镜头语言：主体略偏一侧、前景有虚化的遮挡物形成纵深。画面还带有其他动画特征：极细的描边、有限阶的中间调与稳定的构图。整体干净、精致、不加任何后期锐化。画面不要文字、字幕或水印。
styles.craftEn: Expressionistic overpainting: violent brush direction and clashing colour applied in a first pass rather than built up through careful blending.
styles.craftZh: 骗 AI 交出「官方截图」的关键层：一层薄胶片颗粒 + 广播级的轻微压缩感，能立刻让画面脱离 AI 插画的长相。

styles.desc: 80 年代对未来幻想的遗骸：粉青配色、透视网格地面、廉价感的铬金属立体字、故障与时间码界面。强装饰性。
styles.note: 它是「美学流派」不是角色画法，通常与背景/海报构图搭配
styles.demo: vaporwave landscape, infinite grid floor, chrome statue, pastel pink and teal sky, retro 80s computer graphics aesthetic, glitch artifacts
styles.gpt: Vaporwave retro-futurist illustration: a lone figure standing before an endless chrome grid receding toward an enormous pastel sun. Assemble the aesthetic deliberately from its parts, primitive wireframe computer graphics and low-polygon objects rendered with naive flat lighting, gradient skies running hot pink into soft teal, chrome extrusions mirroring that same gradient across their bevels, and scattered fragments of classical statuary standing in for scenery. Lay a hazy scanline atmosphere over the whole frame and keep a strict pastel script with no pure black. Compose symmetrically around one strong vanishing point. No readable text, logos, watermarks or UI.
styles.gptZh: 复古未来主义插画：一座无限延伸的网格广场，远处是铬合金雕塑与粉紫色的天空。视觉语言是八十年代的模拟技术想象——透视网格地面、铬金属立体造型、扫描线故障与时间码界面元素、噪点与 VHS 色偏。配色是标志性的粉青双色渐变加高对比的黑，饱和度极高。构图是正中央对称的强透视，网格向地平线收敛。整体有怀旧的未来感与数字时代初期的乐观气质。画面不要可读文字或数字，界面元素只保留形状与条块，不要水印。
styles.craftEn: Realist-inflected drawing with measured tonal gradation and warm, low-chroma colour, avoiding stylisation in either direction.
styles.craftZh: 80 年代对未来幻想的遗骸：粉青配色、透视网格地面、廉价感的铬金属立体字、故障与时间码界面。强装饰性。

styles.desc: 动画史第一个程式：四肢像橡胶管任意弯曲不断，白手套、眯缝眼、爵士年代的音乐影响。2010 年代后因游戏改编而大规模复活。
styles.note: 配 film grain 与 monochrome 可复刻黑白时期；配 vibrant colors 则是现代致敬版
styles.demo: cartoon character with noodle-like arms dancing, 1930s rubber hose animation, white gloves, pie-cut eyes, vintage film grain, bouncy motion, black and white
styles.gpt: Nineteen-thirties rubber-hose cartoon still: a cheerful animal character in white gloves dancing along a picket fence under a paper moon. Follow the era's rules exactly, every limb drawn as a flexible hose bending through smooth continuous curves with no elbow or knee joint ever indicated, four-fingered white gloves on both hands, pie-cut eyes with a wedge removed, and the body assembled from simple stacked circles and teardrops. Build the motion bouncy and anticipatory even though the frame is frozen, and keep the background as flat minimal cutout shapes. Render it black-and-white with heavy jittering film grain and a simple horizon line. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 1930 年代橡胶管动画风格插画：一名快活的角色在厨房里跳舞。造型是彻底的弹性形变——身体像橡胶管一样能拉长压扁、绕过物体、手脚可以伸到画面之外；关节没有可辨识的骨骼结构，肢体末端可以弯成任何形状。动作夸张到失去物理逻辑，每个动作之间留一点定格感。造型是纯黑色的剪影配平涂色块，不做体积塑造，眼睛是大白点。背景简洁、色彩艳丽。整体滑稽、动态、充满弹性。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Chinese ink-wash animation conventions: brush-driven line, ink wash gradation, reserved white space, and pigment used sparingly as local accents.
styles.craftZh: 动画史第一个程式：四肢像橡胶管任意弯曲不断，白手套、眯缝眼、爵士年代的音乐影响。2010 年代后因游戏改编而大规模复活。

styles.desc: 把三十年代的橡皮管动画用真正的水彩逐帧画出来：纸纹可见、颜料浓淡不匀、铅笔稿线残留边缘。近年最被模仿的复古流派之一。
styles.note: 关键在「纸与水的质感」，务必加 paper texture 与 visible pencil lines
styles.demo: cup-headed cartoon character running, cuphead style, hand-painted watercolor on paper, visible pencil construction lines, sepia aged palette, 1930s rubber hose limbs
styles.gpt: 1930s rubber-hose era hand-painted animation still drawn in vintage watercolour on paper: a cup-headed character sprinting across a grassy platform toward a grinning boss. Reproduce the analogue production method honestly, real watercolor painted on paper so that pigment pools unevenly at the edge of every shape and bleeds softly across boundaries, visible blue pencil construction lines deliberately left under the color, and a gray shadow wash brushed in at form boundaries rather than clean gradients. Use the warm sepia-tinted early Technicolor scheme, then add fine paper tooth, occasional speckle and dust so the surface reads as actual painted cels. Compose a bouncy full-body run cycle. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 手绘水彩动画风格插画：一名杯子角色在擂台上迎战。水彩的处理是关键——所有形体有明显的深色水彩描边，色块边缘带水彩特有的锯齿与深浅不均的沉积，颜色层叠处能看到叠色。画面充满「手绘感」的不完全规整：线条有轻微的抖动，形体边缘不像数字绘图那样干净。背景是快速绘制的水彩概括——树影与建筑只用几笔带过，重色点放在角色身上。配色以暖褐与深绿为主，高光留纸白。整体有复古手绘动画的粗粝质感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Western television animation conventions with confident elastic posing, smear frames, and a bright, high-contrast palette.
styles.craftZh: 把三十年代的橡皮管动画用真正的水彩逐帧画出来：纸纹可见、颜料浓淡不匀、铅笔稿线残留边缘。近年最被模仿的复古流派之一。

styles.desc: 埃尔热在《丁丁历险记》确立的欧漫学派：线条粗细完全均匀、色块平涂几乎无阴影，而背景却画得极其写实。人物简、环境繁，是它最大的反差点。
styles.note: 不要加 soft shading 或 gradient，会破坏这个流派的核心——均匀线与平涂
styles.demo: young reporter with spiky hair and dog on european street, ligne claire style, uniform thin outlines, flat unmodeled colors, highly detailed realistic architecture behind
styles.gpt: Ligne claire clear-line illustration in the Herge tradition: a young reporter walking his fox terrier through a busy European harbour street. Apply the discipline strictly, a single absolutely uniform line weight with no expressive variation anywhere in the frame, no hatching and no gradient, each object filled with flat unmodeled local color, yet the background drawn with researched accuracy down to individual ship rigging, tram wires and stone kerbing. Reduce the characters to clean readable silhouettes that never compete with that detail. Compose a slightly theatrical mid-shot at eye level. Any signage must carry no readable characters. No logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 清晰线条派插画，线条是唯一造型手段：一名记者站在采访现场。严格遵守「只用线、不用填充」的原则——所有明暗与体积都靠平行排线的疏密来表达，绝不用灰色块面或渐变上色；画面里唯一允许的平涂色是角色的少数几处点缀（如领带），其余全是黑白。线条粗细有明确层级：主体轮廓最粗，背景建筑最细，阴影用交叉排线。整体干净、理性、信息层次极清晰，构图有大量留白。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Hand-painted background art conventions: gouache texture, layered atmospheric recession, and no visible digital linework.
styles.craftZh: 埃尔热在《丁丁历险记》确立的欧漫学派：线条粗细完全均匀、色块平涂几乎无阴影，而背景却画得极其写实。人物简、环境繁，是它最大的反差点。

styles.desc: 爱尔兰 Cartoon Saloon 的视觉语言：角色被压成扁平几何块面，背景布满凯尔特纹样与装饰花草，配色取自中世纪手抄本。
styles.note: 重点是「角色扁平、背景繁复」，写 ornamental background patterns 最有效
styles.demo: girl with wolf companion in irish forest, cartoon saloon style, flat geometric character shapes, ornate celtic decorative foliage, warm earth and teal palette, hand-drawn texture
styles.gpt: Irish hand-drawn animation still in the Cartoon Saloon tradition: a boy walking beneath autumn trees along a stone wall toward distant round towers. Build the frame out of ornament, flat geometric shapes assembled like a page from an illuminated manuscript, foliage reduced to repeatable decorative units rather than observed botany, deep teal and gilt set against warm earth ochre, and every surface carrying visible chalk or pastel grain. Let architectural detail echo Celtic knotwork and manuscript borders, and flatten the perspective deliberately so the scene reads like a tapestry. Compose symmetrically with a high horizon and rich pattern edge to edge. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 手绘装饰动画插画，装饰性几何纹样主导：一名少年站在爱尔兰海边的礁石上。画面充满高度图形化的装饰——海浪画成重复的螺旋与卷草纹样，天空用编织状的几何条带，岩石与云都用有节奏感的弧线组织成图案。造型是简化的、几何的、略带民俗装饰感的；配色大面积使用饱和的绿、蓝与橙，并用金色线条勾勒。整体有一种手工织毯般的平面装饰性，笔触松弛但形状规整。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Neon-noir animation conventions: near-monochrome base with two saturated accent hues, wet-ground reflection, and low-key lighting throughout.
styles.craftZh: 爱尔兰 Cartoon Saloon 的视觉语言：角色被压成扁平几何块面，背景布满凯尔特纹样与装饰花草，配色取自中世纪手抄本。

styles.desc: 法国比利时一脉的童书插画：墨线松动、水彩色块溢出了轮廓，配色含蓄带灰，形体夸张但不追求精致。与日式那种一尘不染的干净正好相反。
styles.note: 要有意识地让颜色「溢出」线外，写成 loose watercolor bleed
styles.demo: small figure walking through old european village in rain, european illustration style, loose ink lines with watercolor bleeding outside outlines, muted grey-blue palette
styles.gpt: European picture-book watercolor illustration: an elderly postman cycling past canal houses during first snow. Keep the handling loose and literate, dry-brush ink contours drawn with a worn nib so the line skips and scratches across the paper texture, watercolor pooled unevenly and allowed to run past the drawn edge in places, a restrained palette of slate blue and dusty rose, and bare paper showing through the majority of the surface. Give the figures whimsical slightly awkward proportions and let atmospheric perspective carry the storytelling. Leave a wide clean margin of untouched paper around the whole scene. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 欧洲绘本水彩插画：一个小男孩在森林小路上走着，前面是一只叼着帽子的狐狸。构图与配色是典型欧式绘本的克制——低饱和的水彩色，褐、绿、蓝为主，画面中央留出干净的空白区域安置主体。造型是圆润概括的简笔式，细节只给关键处（帽子的质感、狐狸的尾巴）。水彩画法保留纸白做亮部，边缘有颜料自然渗开的感觉，铅笔起稿线隐约可见。背景用几笔概括的树影与雾。整体温柔、有故事感、适合亲子阅读。画面不要文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Mecha design conventions: layered mechanical plate armour, hard-surface panel lines, functional-looking joints, and a small cockpit proportion set into a large frame.
styles.craftZh: 法国比利时一脉的童书插画：墨线松动、水彩色块溢出了轮廓，配色含蓄带灰，形体夸张但不追求精致。与日式那种一尘不染的干净正好相反。

styles.desc: 把黏土雕像逐格拍摄：表面留下指纹与工具痕，道具比例略显笨拙，光照是真实的摄影棚光。微型场景的实体感是它区别于 CG 的根本。
styles.note: 必加 practical lighting 与 miniature set，让画面呈现「实拍灯光」而非渲染光
styles.demo: clay-sculpted figure standing in tiny handmade room, claymation stop motion, visible fingerprints on clay surface, practical warm set lighting, detailed miniature props
styles.gpt: Claymation stop-motion still: a lumpy clay inventor standing in his cluttered workshop holding a sputtering brass contraption. Make the material absolutely convincing, every surface covered in fingerprints, thumb dents and fingernail smoothing marks, faint seams where separately sculpted pieces were joined, and tiny dust motes clinging to the plasticine. Give the props slightly wrong proportions because a human hand built them quickly, and leave tell-tale imperfections such as chipped elbow edges and relief from the internal armature at the neck. Light it as a genuine miniature set with practical lamp bounce and very shallow depth of field. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 黏土定格动画插画：一名面包师在厨房里揉面。核心是黏土质感——所有形体表面有指腹按压的凹凸与轻微的指纹弧痕，转折处能看到捏塑的拉丝，边缘圆润没有锐角。定格动画的痕迹必须保留：画面里有一小块可见的工作台材质背景（一角木头或铁架），地面带轻微的阴影位移；动作停在某一帧的中途，四肢姿态不对称。材质层次丰富——布料、木头、金属、黏土各有不同的表面质感。构图近景，光线是柔和的顶光。整体温暖、手作、有真实的物理痕迹。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Fantasy-race illustration conventions with decorative costume pattern, cool jewel-tone colour, and long flowing silhouette lines.
styles.craftZh: 把黏土雕像逐格拍摄：表面留下指纹与工具痕，道具比例略显笨拙，光照是真实的摄影棚光。微型场景的实体感是它区别于 CG 的根本。

styles.desc: 德国先驱洛特·莱尼格确立的技法：角色是铰链式黑色剪影，背景用半透明的剪纸分层背光打亮。被视为欧洲艺术动画的源头之一。
styles.note: 背光是关键：写 backlit paper layers 才能出现那种通透的层叠感
styles.demo: black paper silhouette figure with jointed limbs in ancient tale scene, lotte reiniger style, translucent backlit papercut background layers, warm amber glow
styles.gpt: Silhouette and papercut animation still in the German cut-paper tradition: a princess fleeing through a paper forest with plainly visible jointed limbs. Build every element as cut paper, the figures cut from opaque black card, the background foliage from translucent layered paper so that colored backlight filters through layer after layer at diminishing intensity, and each piece showing its cut edge with a thin curl shadow underneath. Restrict motion to joint rotation only, and light the entire scene from behind the plane through graded colored gels. Compose within a theatrical proscenium frame. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 剪纸与剪影动画插画：一只鹿在月光下的林间穿行。整幅由纯黑剪影构成，层次全靠剪影的疏密与负空间来表达——前景的枝叶是深黑，中景的鹿是稍浅的黑，背景的月亮与天空留白。剪影边缘保持手撕或剪刀剪出的不规则感，略微毛糙；内部的镂空细节（如鹿的耳朵、腿的关节）用手工剪出的孔洞表现。构图讲究：主体鹿的剪影压在画面中央，枝条从上方切入形成画框。整体是纯粹的黑白剪纸语言，质感安静。画面不要文字、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Contemporary webtoon illustration conventions: vertical scroll rhythm, generous panel spacing, selective detail concentrated on the face, and simplified backgrounds.
styles.craftZh: 德国先驱洛特·莱尼格确立的技法：角色是铰链式黑色剪影，背景用半透明的剪纸分层背光打亮。被视为欧洲艺术动画的源头之一。

styles.desc: 一九五〇年代美国 UPA 工作室的反写实运动：把形体压到最少的线条、平面图形成像海报、用极少的帧表达动作。设计先于写实。
styles.note: 这是后无数扁平风格的总源头，写 poster-like composition 能快速对齐
styles.demo: stylized figure leaning against off-kilter wall, upa limited animation style, simplified graphic shapes, bold flat color areas, modernist poster composition, tilted perspective
styles.gpt: Modernist limited-animation still in the UPA tradition: a jazz musician leaning against a hydrant in a stylized city square. Honor the mid-century design revolt, figures reduced to graphic abstracted marks, bold flat areas of unmodeled color with no attempt at realistic shading, deliberate anatomical distortion in service of the line rather than the body, and a background laid out like a modernist poster with skewed off-kilter perspective and unexpected negative counter-forms. Add print-like ink texture and edges sitting very slightly off register. Compose strong asymmetric balance like a screenprint. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 有限动画现代主义插画，风格化到极致的扁平图形：一名上班族在办公室里走过。造型被大胆简化成几何形状——人物是流畅的曲线团块，五官简化成点与短线的组合，甚至可以把人体画成近乎抽象的形状。颜色是大面积的平涂色块，配色克制协调（不超过三个主色）。背景用简洁的几何化场景暗示，不画细节。构图讲究平衡与留白，节奏是优雅的慢动作感，姿态舒展。整体极简、优雅、有现代主义设计感。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Retro printmaking conventions: limited spot colour, visible halftone or misregistration, and a paper-toned base.
styles.craftZh: 一九五〇年代美国 UPA 工作室的反写实运动：把形体压到最少的线条、平面图形成像海报、用极少的帧表达动作。设计先于写实。

styles.desc: 把报刊、布料、实景照片撕贴进画面：材质之间的接缝与撕边都保留，制造出真实与虚构交错的质感。实验动画与独立 MV 常用。
styles.note: 指定 torn edges 与 mismatched textures，别追求整洁，杂乱本身就是语言
styles.demo: portrait assembled from torn magazine pieces and fabric scraps, collage animation style, visible torn edges, mismatched printed textures, surreal layered composition
styles.gpt: Collage and mixed-media animated still: a woman's portrait assembled entirely from torn paper, fabric swatches and cut photographic fragments. Exploit the physical layering, torn fiber edges catching light with real thickness, mismatched scale between pasted elements so the hand and face were clearly printed separately, visible glue sheen and buckling paper, and seams left deliberately unresolved where two source images meet. Let different regions flip between drawn line, printed halftone and flat painted block. Compose the figure frontally against a heavily worked textured ground. Keep it tactile and assembled, never digitally smooth. No readable text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 拼贴与混合媒介插画：一名潜水员站在海底。整幅由多种材质拼贴而成——剪纸的硬边、水彩的软边、印刷的网点、报纸的纹理、手写的墨线混在一起，接缝刻意保留。每一种材质有它自己的表面质感：纸有纤维、布有织纹、照片有光泽。构图是拼贴式的刻意不对称，元素之间有重叠关系。色彩来自不同来源，因此略微不统一，这种不统一正是拼贴的味道。整体层次丰富、有触感、有手工感。画面不要可读文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Stained-glass and mosaic animation conventions: every shape bounded by a heavy black lead line, colour held flat within each cell.
styles.craftZh: 把报刊、布料、实景照片撕贴进画面：材质之间的接缝与撕边都保留，制造出真实与虚构交错的质感。实验动画与独立 MV 常用。

styles.desc: 孔版机印刷的独立出版物美学：只用两三个专色叠印，故意错位的套印偏移，网点与油墨不匀。近年独立动画与社媒视觉的常客。
styles.note: 限定 2~3 个专色，并写 misregistration 才会有那股套印不准的味道
styles.demo: two-color illustration of figure in doorway, risograph print style, limited spot colors only, slight misregistration offset, halftone dot texture, indie zine feel
styles.gpt: Risograph print style indie illustration: a cyclist riding past sunflowers beneath an enormous low sun. Restrict yourself to two spot colors, fluorescent orange and medium blue, printed as separate translucent layers so every overlap produces one predictable third color.
