Run the registration slightly off so one layer drifts a few millimetres across the sheet, and let the ink land as coarse halftone dot pattern with uneven coverage, occasional voids and soft mottling where the drum ran dry. Use matte absorbent paper with visible fiber. Compose flat and poster-like with no depth illusion. No readable text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 孔版印刷质感插画：一名潜水员在海底。画面模仿孔版印刷的工艺限制——颜色层数被限制在三到四色，每一层都能看到独立的套印错位与边缘的重叠；网点与颗粒是印刷的产物而非绘制。颜色取双色调或三色的有限套，通常以一个暖色加一个冷色为主，叠出第三色。墨色不均、油墨在纸上有轻微的溢出。构图简洁、形状概括，只用一两个大色块与线条。整体有独立出版物的低成本而有质感的气质。画面不要可读文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Paper-cut and silhouette-stop-motion animation conventions: layered cut paper, visible material texture, and warm theatrical lighting with soft shadow edges.
styles.craftZh: 孔版机印刷的独立出版物美学：只用两三个专色叠印，故意错位的套印偏移，网点与油墨不匀。近年独立动画与社媒视觉的常客。

styles.desc: 为低龄阅读而生的画法：轮廓柔和无害、配色温暖、构图清楚到一眼看懂。与日式萌系区别在于线条更松弛、更偏手绘童趣而非工业精致。
styles.note: 想做亲子绘本、教具、儿童封面时，这一层比市面上任何 anime 标签都合适
styles.demo: little fox reading under mushroom in sunny meadow, children's book illustration style, soft friendly rounded shapes, gentle ink lines, warm storybook palette
styles.gpt: Children's picture-book illustration: a small bear in a yellow raincoat rowing a wooden boat across a pond at dusk. Draw for a young reader, soft rounded forms with no sharp corners anywhere in frame, friendly characters with large eyes and instantly legible expressions, gently wobbly hand-drawn outlines, and a warm storybook scheme anchored by ochre and soft teal. Keep the composition simple with one obvious focal point, and give the environment just enough hidden detail to reward repeated looking. Build the texture from crayon and colored pencil strokes over visible paper grain. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 童书绘本插画：一只兔子在森林里给蘑菇撑伞。造型是圆头圆脑的可爱比例，四肢短小，五官简化为点与弧线；兔子的耳朵要能透过伞下看到，构成画面的一个小转折。画法是温暖的、有手绘质感的：线稿柔软，填色略带不均匀，边界不追求精准。背景处理大胆——只画几块色彩分明的形状来表示树林，层次靠色块的深浅排开。构图居中偏上，给脚下的草地留出空间。颜色饱和但不刺眼，是那种会让人觉得被照顾到的配色。整体温暖、有童趣、适合睡前阅读。画面不要文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Mid-century advertising illustration conventions: confident single-weight contour, limited palette, exaggerated foreshortening, and a lot of empty ground.
styles.craftZh: 为低龄阅读而生的画法：轮廓柔和无害、配色温暖、构图清楚到一眼看懂。与日式萌系区别在于线条更松弛、更偏手绘童趣而非工业精致。

styles.desc: 逐帧描摹真人影像：动作格外流畅真实，却因偶尔的形变而透出隐隐的不安。常用于成人动画与实验作品。
styles.note: 它自带恐怖谷感，想表达日常就配合暖色，想表达惊悚就配冷灰
styles.demo: figure walking down street drawn from live footage, rotoscoping style, uncannily fluid realistic motion, thin even ink outline, desaturated documentary palette
styles.gpt: Rotoscoped animation still: a boxer throwing a hook, traced frame by frame over live-action reference footage. Sell the uncanny accuracy of traced motion, every joint following what a real body actually did, which produces slightly wrong drawn proportions and shifting line quality as the tracer corrected between frames, with inked outlines wobbling erratically over the recorded movement instead of holding a steady contour. Keep the shading flat and sparse. Keep the background drawn loosely and differently from the figures so life and illustration sit uneasily together. Use flat limited color and no digital smoothing anywhere. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 转描现实主义插画：以真人素材的清晰线条为起点，再转为绘画化处理。画面必须保留「转描」特有的痕迹——一条条均匀、机械的轮廓线把每个形体边缘勾出来，包括本该柔和的边缘；线下的形体内部是平涂色块，颜色比轮廓线更饱和，像着色书页。这个「线框在上、色彩在下」的错位关系是风格的关键。线条本身没有情绪，粗细变化很小。构图与姿态来自真实素材的抓拍感，带着一点不完美的偶然。整体有一种「图纸与成稿之间」的特殊质感。画面不要文字或水印。
styles.craftEn: Contemporary digital concept-art conventions: broad value masses establishing form first, colour temperature separation between light and shadow, and selective detail only where the eye lands.
styles.craftZh: 逐帧描摹真人影像：动作格外流畅真实，却因偶尔的形变而透出隐隐的不安。常用于成人动画与实验作品。

styles.desc: 以尤里·诺尔施泰因为代表的一脉：玻璃油画的层叠、明显厚涂的水粉背景、斯拉夫民间服饰与民歌节奏。情绪常是诗意而忧伤的童话。
styles.note: 必须写 detailed oil-on-glass layers，这是它区别于日本水彩背景的核心工艺
styles.demo: small animal wandering misty autumn forest at dusk, soviet animation style, oil paint on glass layers, textured gouache trees, melancholic fairy tale mood, soft golden light
styles.gpt: Soviet and Eastern European hand-drawn animation still: a melancholy wolf walking through snow-heavy pine woods at blue twilight. Recreate the studio technique precisely, figures and scenery painted in gouache or oil directly on glass under the camera, producing soft smeared edges and a thick painterly surface, multiplane depth with separate foreground branches sliding past the animal, and Slavic folk ornament recurring inside the tree forms and drifted snow patterns. Hold the palette cold blue and umber broken only by one warm window glow far off. Compose a heavy wide shot with deep layered forest recession. No text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 苏联与东欧手绘动画插画：一名炼金术士在实验室里工作。造型是厚重的手绘感——形体胖而结实，线条粗重有力，上色厚实且边界清晰；人物的表情带着一种庄严的凝滞，动作幅度不大但姿态有分量。色彩是那个年代的印刷调——深绿、赭红、暗金与褐黑色，饱和度统一偏高，像旧油墨的质感。背景与道具的细节极为丰富：仪器、书本、烛台都画出来，构图的装饰性很强。整体有一种庄严、怀旧、装饰性浓的古典动画气质。画面不要文字、字母或水印。
styles.craftEn: Screen-print poster conventions: two or three flat inks, hard-edged registration, deliberately coarse halftone, and minimal tonal gradation.
styles.craftZh: 以尤里·诺尔施泰因为代表的一脉：玻璃油画的层叠、明显厚涂的水粉背景、斯拉夫民间服饰与民歌节奏。情绪常是诗意而忧伤的童话。

styles.desc: 中世纪教堂玻璃窗的语言：黑色铅线分割大块彩色玻璃、光从背后穿透。常用于神圣题材、历史回忆、以及宗教主题的海报构图。
styles.note: 写 backlit translucent light 才有那种「透光的色」；黑线是结构线不能省
styles.demo: saintly figure rendered as church stained glass window, bold black lead lines dividing colored glass panels, backlit translucent glow, gold leaf accents, vertical arched composition
styles.gpt: Stained glass and mosaic animated still: a robed saint standing beneath a gothic rose window with light driving through it. Construct everything as leaded glass, every shape bounded by a heavy black lead line, infilled with flat translucent jewel color, the whole lit from behind so that light passes through the material rather than reflecting off its surface. Add irregular bubble striations and variation within each glass piece, gold leaf accents throwing stronger beams into the air, and mosaic tile work across the floor. Compose with hard vertical symmetry and keep nothing crossing outside the window arch. No readable text, logos or watermarks.
styles.gptZh: 花窗玻璃与马赛克插画：一名圣徒般的人物站在教堂窗前。整幅由玻璃块组成——每一片区域都被粗重的黑色铅条划分，形状是有机的、略带手绘不规则的碎片；颜色在玻璃片内完全平涂，透出强逆光，让每一片都像自己在发光。构图是完全对称的、教堂式的垂直分割，主体被安排在画面正中的窄长格内。底部与顶部用马赛克小方块做边饰，花样是几何与植物的组合。整体是发光的、宗教式的、装饰性极强的质感。画面不要可读字符、标志或水印。
styles.craftEn: Leaded-glass animation conventions: heavy black leading bounding every element, luminous transmitted colour, and long light shafts driving through the composition.
styles.craftZh: 中世纪教堂玻璃窗的语言：黑色铅线分割大块彩色玻璃、光从背后穿透。常用于神圣题材、历史回忆、以及宗教主题的海报构图。

genres.desc: 少年漫画主流战斗作品的视觉语言：决定性姿势、集中线、冲击帧、能量气场与面部坚毅表情。构图一定有「攻击方向」。
genres.demo: 1boy, battle shonen, dynamic jumping pose, energy aura, speed lines surrounding, intense expression, dramatic low angle
genres.scene: 低角度仰拍强化表现力，背景配放射线或爆炸云；服装加磨损与污渍增加说服力。
genres.gpt: Battle shonen anime illustration: a teenage fighter launching forward through shattered concrete with energy crackling off his shoulders. Use the genre's full vocabulary, one extreme dynamic action pose with readable weight transfer and a single fully extended limb, radial debris implying the impact frame, hard ink speed lines converging on the point of contact, and layered aura effects in a hot secondary hue wrapping the silhouette. Keep the expression resolute rather than screaming. Compose from a low three-quarter angle so he feels larger than the frame, with the camera slightly rotated. Include no text, logos, watermarks or UI elements.
genres.gptZh: 热血战斗场面的动画插画：两名角色在夕阳下的废墟顶端交手，拳锋相接的瞬间。表现「势」的技术要点：接触点画出一圈冲击波与飞散的碎片，人物的姿态夸张到极限、动作线条拉出速度的余韵，脚下的地面被踩出龟裂。人物造型走少年热血路线——身形拉长、五官尖锐、眼神高光强烈。构图为对角线主导的对峙构图，两个身影一前一后压住画面对角。配色用暖橙与深蓝的强对比，天空的夕阳把轮廓染成金色。整体要热、要快、要有即将爆发的张力。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 分写实系（高达：装甲分块、铆钉、军绿配色）与超级系（魔神 Z：夸张胸甲与角）两条路，共同点是硬表面细节。
genres.demo: real robot standing in hangar, hard surface armor panels, detailed hydraulic details, olive and gray military palette, dramatic dawn light, low angle
genres.scene: 机库 Hangar / 战场废墟；常写 low angle looking up 表现体量压迫感。
genres.gpt: Hard-surface mecha anime illustration: a single-seat combat walker crouched on a shattered highway overpass at dusk. Design it strictly as machinery, panel breaks following believable load paths, exposed hydraulic pistons at knee and elbow, mechanical detail density highest around the cockpit, canopy and sensor glass holding believable tint and reflection, and a matte military finish in olive, slate and sand without any stencilled marking. Add chipped paint at leading edges and dried hydraulic staining. Put a tiny human silhouette on the road below to fix the scale. Compose a three-quarter view. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 机甲题材动画插画：一台机甲站在雨中城市的废墟广场上。机体的机械设定必须可信——外露的关节转轴与液压杆、可见的线束与铆钉、装甲板之间有明确的结构连接。上色是硬边两阶加网点纸中间调，表面材质分哑光涂层、金属高光与橡胶关节三档。驾驶舱的玻璃反射出微弱的城市灯光。雨是斜向落下的，在机甲的肩甲上溅开。构图取略仰的全景，把人物（很小）放进画面以显机体的尺度。配色以铁灰、警示橙与冷蓝为主。整体沉重、有重量、有战争后的荒凉感。画面不要文字、编号或水印。

genres.desc: 以日本甲胄 / 和装为核心的东方武斗系。分两派：写实克制刀法的时代剧，与刀光剑气夸张的少年漫。
genres.demo: samurai in dark hakama, katana drawn, bamboo forest background, moonlight rim light, ink-influenced atmosphere, dynamic slash motion
genres.scene: 竹林、道场、月下屋顶、樱花庭园；横向构图最适合表现拔刀的瞬间。
genres.gpt: Japanese historical action anime still: a swordsman in dark indigo hakama holding iaijutsu stance in a bamboo forest at dawn. Draw the period accurately, layered kosode and hakama with correct wrapped seams and tied obi, the blade held in a genuine ready position with a visible temper line along the edge, straw sandals, and a headband trailing on the morning wind. Let low shafts of sunlight cut through dense bamboo with dust suspended in every beam, and push the forest back into deep green recession. Compose a wide shot with the blade still sheathed so the tension stays unspent. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 忍者与武士题材的动画插画：一名蒙面忍者蹲在京都的屋檐上，远处是寺庙的轮廓。人物设计要能分辨时代：忍者的装束是深色的紧身衣加分段护具，腰间别短刀；远处武士的装束是层叠的甲胄与宽檐斗笠。建筑是有细节的日式木构——瓦片、木格窗、垂下的灯笼。动态处理讲究：忍者的姿态是压低重心的准备动作，布料与绳索有自然的滞后飘动。构图取对角线，用屋脊的线条把视线引向远处的武士。配色用深靛蓝与朱红对比，晨雾柔化远景。整体克制、有紧张感、有古典质感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.zh: 特摄战队 / 变身英雄
genres.desc: 不是动画却胜似动画：皮套质感、面具目镜、变身定格的光带与烟火爆点。重点是材质的皮革与塑料反光。
genres.demo: five colored hero suits posing together, sentai lineup, glossy helmet visors, stage smoke, dynamic cool angles, retro tokusatsu poster
genres.scene: 巨大化战斗、经典的变身变奏长镜头；建议 16:9 画幅，保留特摄的舞台感。
genres.gpt: Tokusatsu live-action hero still: a suited henshin hero landing among rubble in an industrial yard. Photograph a real physical suit rather than drawing one, moulded helmet with a tinted visor catching the key light, reinforced spandex with visible seam paneling, chest and shoulder armor each carrying a different gloss level, and practical tokusatsu effects such as genuine dust charges, smoke and physical sparks. Broaden the martial pose until it reads cleanly at a distance. Light with hard direct sun and a fill board from camera left. Compose a heroic low-angle shot. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 特摄战队风格的动画插画：五名英雄并肩站在雨中的城市广场上。造型语言是硬朗的装甲分区——每个部位有独立的分件线与明确的颜色分色，腰部有统一的连接件；配色是饱和的红、蓝、黄为主色加黑白辅助，整体锐利不柔和。画面有战队的仪式感：五人等距排列、姿态各异但朝向一致，脚下是被水浸湿的反光地面。战斗的痕迹要保留——装甲上有划痕，地面积水有涟漪与倒影。构图为对称的低角度仰视，强化英雄感。整体明亮、有正气、有年代感。画面不要文字、数字或水印。

genres.desc: 强调制服细节、枪械 / 战车、硝烟，色彩低饱和，画面常追求「平静中的残酷」。
genres.demo: young soldier sitting in ruined trench, detailed military uniform, dust particles, cold morning light, desaturated earth tones, cinematic wide shot
genres.scene: 战场远景 + 冷色调；角色动作姿态要避免过于潇洒，以免失真。
genres.gpt: Military war anime illustration: a squad moving through the ruins of a shelled town under flat overcast sky. Keep it procedural and unglamorous, period-consistent uniforms and load-bearing equipment, webbing, pouches and radio antennas rather than costume styling, dust and smoke hanging motionless in the air with no romantic fire glow, and a desaturated scheme of olive, sand and cold grey. Show fatigue in the anatomy and posture, and weight carried low. Compose a wide documentary-style frame with the soldiers small and spacing discipline legible to anyone who has served. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 军事与战争题材的动画插画：一名士兵站在被炮火摧毁的街道上，远处是升起的烟尘。战争的表现要有重量而不是英雄化——废墟的断面是真实的钢筋与碎砖，坦克的履带痕迹压过地面，人物的姿态是疲惫的而非威武。光是低角度的午后阳光，穿过烟尘形成明显的体积光柱，空气里飘着灰烬。色彩整体压成低饱和的黄褐与灰，只有一点制服的深蓝作为人的标识。构图取中远景，用前景的残骸做画框。整体沉痛、真实、有战争的疲惫感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 靠「参照物」制造体量：城市尺度、远景中极小的人影、笼罩全身的暗影。刻意省略细节反而更可怕。
genres.demo: gigantic creature emerging from smoke above city, tiny human silhouettes below, scale contrast, dark clouds, dramatic rim light, epic wide shot
genres.scene: 低机位 + 巨大阴影笼罩；加浅景深，让人与巨兽形成清晰的体量对比。
genres.gpt: Kaiju colossal-scale anime illustration: an enormous creature rising out of a harbour beyond a night city skyline. Sell the size through comparison rather than surface detail, keep one or two tiny human silhouettes on a foreground rooftop for scale, seat the creature low on the horizon beneath heavy ominous cloud, and let a rolling destruction wave of spray and debris run ahead of it into the shoreline. Render detail selectively so form stays legible without ever turning domestic. Use dense backlit fog and heavy atmospheric perspective across the whole middle distance. Compose an extreme panorama. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 巨型怪兽题材的动画插画：一头巨兽从海中升起，小小的渔船在它脚下。巨物感全靠对比建立——怪兽占满画面高度，而船与人被压到极小；怪兽的每一步都让海面产生放射状的浪。怪兽的皮肤要画得有分量：粗厚的鳞片与褶皱、背脊的骨板、湿润反光的高光。动态表现怪兽抬起前肢的瞬间，水花与雨被动作带起。构图用极低机位仰视，天空被巨兽的身体占满。海与天用高对比的冷色，人物用暖色点缀。整体压迫、有恐惧感、有真实的体量。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: JRPG 与《指环王》谱系：骑士板甲、法师长袍、精灵建筑、巨石废墟。核心词是「厚重的历史感与泛光魔法」。
genres.demo: elven mage casting spell in ancient ruins, plate armor details, glowing runes particles, volumetric god rays, fantasy landscape background
genres.scene: 哥特教堂、古代遗迹、地下城；光源由魔法泛光主导。
genres.gpt: High fantasy anime illustration: an armored adventurer and a robed mage standing in the overgrown ruins of an elven hall. Build believable world detail, plate armor with real articulation and strap construction rather than drawn-on sculpting, a staff carved rather than manufactured, architecture following tall elvish proportion with weathered stone and forest slowly reclaiming the floor, and glowing runes acting as the only warm light source. Keep adventuring gear worn, repaired and mismatched. Compose a wide key visual with strong vertical columns and light dropping through a collapsed ceiling. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 剑与魔法西幻题材的动画插画：一名披着斗篷的冒险者站在古老石桥上，面对峡谷对岸的城堡。世界的设定要可信——中世纪的石砌建筑有真实的受力结构（扶壁、拱券、垛口），魔法不是随手放出的光效而是有代价的：施法者的身体被反噬扭曲，元素在空气中留下残留物。角色装备是冒险者式的实用组合——旅行斗篷、皮甲、磨损的剑。构图取广角中景，石桥的透视把视线引向城堡。光线是被云层过滤后的柔和冷光。整体厚重、有真实感、有旅途的疲惫。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 近十年最大题材：现代人来到奇幻世界。视觉公式是「现代感角色 + 剑与魔法背景」。
genres.demo: modern boy reincarnated as knight, fantasy medieval town background, adventurer gear, summoning magic circle remnants, bright adventure palette
genres.scene: 冒险者公会、中世纪街道、地牢入口；强化现代角色与环境之间的反差感。
genres.gpt: Isekai anime illustration: a bewildered young man in modern clothing standing in a fantasy town square still clutching a convenience-store item. Stage the collision explicitly, contemporary sneakers, windbreaker and plastic bag set against hand-cobbled stone, heavy timber framing and a guildhall facade, with a summoning magic circle fading beneath his feet and its last blue embers lifting into the air. Populate the background with genuinely nonhuman townsfolk going about entirely ordinary business. Compose a wide frame in which the world visibly dwarfs him. Render signage without readable characters. No logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 异世界转生题材的动画插画：一名现代装束的人站在异世界村镇的街道上，手里还拿着原本世界的物品。这个题材的核心视觉是「两套体系同框」——现代的塑料拉链与异世界的皮绳剑袋挂在一起。村镇的设定要具体：木石混构的建筑、晾晒的织物、田地的形状都比现实世界多一层不可解释的规整。表情要表现困惑——眉头微皱、目光在环境与手中物品之间来回。构图中景，用环境的怪异细节讲故事。光线是黄昏的暖光，与异世界的冷色魔法残留形成反差。整体有「哪里不对」的微妙感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 变身段落 + 蕾丝层次 + 星月符号 + 粉彩配色。从美少女战士的复古到小圆的暗黑都可由此分支。
genres.demo: magical girl mid-transformation, frilly pink dress with ribbons, glowing wand, floating stars and bubbles, pastel palette, cheerful pose
genres.scene: 星空背景、花瓣 / 泡泡、变身光带；正面偶像式站姿最稳。
genres.gpt: Magical girl anime illustration captured mid-transformation: a girl suspended in a swirl of ribbons and star sparkles while her costume assembles around her. Hold to the genre's grammar, a frilly layered dress with real petticoat volume and ribbon construction, a wand or compact raised overhead, star and heart motifs repeated consistently through the effects layer, and a pastel scheme anchored by one strongly saturated accent. Render the costume change honestly so parts of it remain unresolved strands of light rather than finished cloth. Compose a vertical full-body leaving generous space above. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 魔法少女题材的动画插画：一名变身中的少女站在夜色的天台上。这个题材的视觉核心是「变身的过程」而不是变身后的样子：光带从体内沿骨骼走向外层，服装正一寸寸成型，法杖在手中凝聚但还没有实体。姿态要有舞蹈感——身体拉成优雅的弧线，手臂与腿形成优雅的角度。场景要选有意义的位置：天台、废弃的钟楼、放学后的屋顶，背后是城市的灯光。构图取旋转的动态对角线，魔法光带构成画面的引导线。配色是粉紫与青蓝的高饱和撞色加深色夜空。整体华丽、优雅、有仪式感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 日本特有妖怪谱系，氛围在「可爱」与「诡异」间摇摆。夏目友人帐式的温柔与千与千寻式的诡谲两条路。
genres.demo: fox-masked girl among paper lanterns, yokai night parade, torii gate background, warm lantern glow against dark blue night, mystical atmosphere
genres.scene: 神社鸟居、提灯长廊、百鬼夜行队列；暖橙灯光 + 冷夜色对比最强。
genres.gpt: Yokai night parade anime illustration: a procession of spirits winding down a stone path lit only by paper lanterns. Blend folklore with ink painting, a kitsune-mask dancer leading the column, lantern glow pooling warm against cold indigo night, smaller will-o-wisps and minor spirits drawn in thinner ink than the principals, and a torii gate silhouetted at the top of the climb. Borrow loose brush handling from sumi-e in the far background while nearer figures stay legibly drawn. Compose a deep procession using repeated lantern rhythm for depth. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 妖怪与百鬼夜行题材的动画插画：一列灯笼在山道上缓缓前行，山下是夜色中的村庄。妖怪的造型要「可辨识又不恐怖」——形体保留动物或器物的特征（长尾、多眼、裂开的器皿），但比例与姿态被赋予人的意图。灯笼是画面的节奏点：一串暖光在深色背景里排开，每一盏都有一小圈的光晕。山道两侧的古树扭曲成遮挡画面的前景。构图用长卷式的横向排列，把视线从近处引向远处的村庄。色调是墨黑与暗青，只有灯笼的暖黄是亮色。整体幽玄、有古意、有行进的仪式感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 希腊 / 北欧 / 埃及神话视觉。关键是大量鎏金装饰与大理石建材，加上「神性光」与符号性构图。
genres.demo: goddess statue coming to life, greek marble temple, golden ornaments, constellation halo, symmetrical divine composition, dramatic light
genres.scene: 神殿、星空、浮雕墙面；对称构图最能出神性。
genres.gpt: Mythology retelling anime illustration: a seated goddess rendered at monumental scale on weathered marble steps beneath a starfield resolving into recognizable constellations. Combine classical ornament with stylized divinity, gold filigree worked into costume and architecture, heavy fluted columns, real constellation patterns above rather than scattered random stars, and divine light that behaves like a volume rather than decorative glow. Keep poses sculptural, proportions idealized, and marble carrying believable veining and weathering. Compose symmetrically with the figure raised well above the viewer. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 神话改编题材的动画插画：一位神祇站在云海之上的神庙前。神话的表现要靠「非日常的尺度」——神祇的躯体明显大于常人，衣饰与器物上有不属于任何已知时代的形制，云与海被神力塑成有秩序的形态而不是自然的随机。姿态是仪式性的、静止的、有重量的。画面里要有神话叙事的痕迹：神庙的浮雕、象征性的动物、以及被神迹改变的地面。构图为仰视的三角构图，神祇居中，云海在下。配色用金属金、深靛与象牙白。整体庄严、有秩序感、有距离感。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.zh: 恶役千金 / 反转重生
genres.desc: 女性向转生的标配：欧式宫廷裙、水晶灯舞会、茶会。关键词是「华丽但带一点算计的眼神」。
genres.demo: villainess in elaborate regency ballgown, royal ballroom with chandelier, confident smirk, candlelight glow, detailed lace and frills
genres.scene: 宫廷舞厅、玫瑰园、贵族学园；灯光偏暖蜡烛。
genres.gpt: Villainess reincarnation anime illustration: a young noblewoman descending a candlelit staircase into a royal ballroom. Give the setting real period weight, an empire-waist gown with layered lace and puffed sleeves, chandeliers reflected in polished parquet, gilt molding, and a tea service laid out on period-correct porcelain. Stage her with the composure of someone who already knows how this story goes, one eyebrow raised while surrounding courtiers collapse into silhouette. Use dramatic single-source lighting from directly above. Compose a wide high-vantage shot looking down the stair. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 恶役千金与反转重生题材的动画插画：一名贵族少女站在宴会的厅堂中央。视觉重点是「表面与实际的反差」——她的礼服华丽到过分，珠宝是沉重的纯金，姿态是无可挑剔的礼仪；而她的眼神里有一种不属于这个位置的东西。环境要把这个反差衬得更狠：厅堂极尽奢华，人却少；仆人的视线不落在她身上。构图取中景，让她处在正中但周围刻意留出一圈空。配色用深红与金构成贵族感，加一点冷色作为她的内心标识。整体华丽中带寒意。画面不要文字、标志或水印。

genres.desc: 高密度都市 + 霓虹 + 阴雨天反光。几乎到了「发霉的半成品美学」：技术越先进，环境越脏。
genres.demo: cyberpunk street at night, dense neon signage, reflections on wet asphalt, lone figure with coat, cyan and magenta lights, light rain, cinematic
genres.scene: 狭窄巷道、雨夜屋顶、密密麻麻的霓虹广告；必加 reflections on wet ground。
genres.gpt: Cyberpunk anime illustration: a courier with a chrome prosthetic arm standing at the mouth of a rain-soaked alley in a stacked megacity. Build real density, signage layered six or seven storeys overhead, exposed cabling and bolted fire escapes, steam venting from street grates, and every wet surface mirroring the neon above it. Light her from competing magenta and cyan sources so both shoulders carry colored rim light while shadows sink toward black. Add broken reflections of unseen crowds in the puddles. Compose a deep wide frame with strong vertical recession. Render any signage without readable characters. No logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 赛博朋克题材的动画插画：一名角色站在夜市的巷口，身后是层层叠叠的招牌与管线。这个题材的视觉语法是「极高密度的细节与极高对比」：画面里塞满全息广告牌、悬空的线缆、破旧的空调外机、摊贩的蒸汽管，但每一件都画清楚，不允许糊成灰。色彩是招牌的品红与青对撞，暗部压到深黑，光源密集且方向不一。角色被多层霓虹照亮，在湿地面留下多重倒影。构图用前景遮挡物形成画框，视线分层。整体信息过载、潮湿、有压迫感。招牌上的字不要可读，只保留抽象的笔画与色块。画面不要水印。

genres.desc: 把游戏 UI 拉进画面的玩法：半透明状态栏、技能栏、掉落提示。近年 UI 元素已成为独立审美。
genres.demo: gamer avatar in fantasy field, translucent game UI overlay, hp bar and skill icons, level up particles, crisp modern anime colors
genres.scene: 悬浮 UI + 虚化的环境背景；注意别让 UI 挡住脸。
genres.gpt: Virtual reality game world anime illustration: a four-person adventurer party facing a dungeon boss inside a stylized raid arena. Keep it readable as a game rather than reality, clean stylized asset construction with unmistakable real-time game lighting, translucent selection panels and a slim resource bar floating near each party member drawn entirely without readable text, level-up sparkles still rising off one character, and a boss health bar framed above the encounter carrying no readable numbers. Give every silhouette clear separation. Compose a wide action tableau from a slightly raised camera. No logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 虚拟现实与游戏世界题材的动画插画：一名角色站在悬浮在虚空中的平台上，头顶悬着半透明的操作界面。这个题材要画出「真实与虚拟的两种材质共存」：实体部分的质感写实（织物的纹理、皮肤的毛孔），虚拟部分则是半透明的发光结构（有网格线、有粒子、有边缘的辉光）。界面的设计要有信息层级而不是纯装饰：主菜单区、状态栏、提示条各有明确的视觉区分。透视很夸张，平台向远处收进雾里。配色是深蓝的虚空加青色与紫色的界面光。整体干净、有纵深、不杂乱。界面文字留空，不要可读字符。画面不要水印。

genres.desc: 浩瀚尺度 + 舰船 + 星际政治叙事。核心是「深黑背景 + 冰冷的硬质感机械光源」。
genres.demo: starship bridge with huge viewport, lone figure watching nebula, cold blue instrument lights, crisp hard surface interior, vast starfield
genres.scene: 舰桥、舷窗远景星球、陨石带；没有浊气，一切要 crisp。
genres.gpt: Space opera anime illustration: a bridge crew silhouetted against a colored nebula from inside a starship command deck. Make the ship feel large and lived-in, a wide console run with believable instrumentation, heavy structural ribs overhead, layered deck levels and grime ground into the floor plating, set against a deep starfield and glowing gas cloud filling the forward viewport. Light the crew almost entirely from that window, keeping every face half in darkness. Leave one small figure standing apart at the rail for scale. Compose a wide atmospheric frame. Include no readable displays, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 太空歌剧题材的动画插画：一艘大型舰船悬停在一颗行星的大气层边缘。这套设定的重量感来自尺度对比——舰船长到画面装不下，两侧的桁架结构与引擎组都有明确的机械连接。行星占满画面下半部，大气层在边缘被阳光照出一条明亮的辉光带。舰船的阴影投射在云层上。材质分档要清楚：装甲板的哑光、舷窗的反射、引擎的炽热。构图取极远景，舰船只占画面上方三分之一，让行星的弧线成为主构图线。配色用行星的深蓝与橙黄大气辉光。整体辽阔、有孤独感、有工业感。画面不要文字、编号或水印。

genres.desc: 时间是视觉符号：钟面、停滞的雨滴、双重曝光、位置上叠加的「过去的自己」。
genres.demo: girl on empty street with frozen raindrops, cracked clock face halo, double exposure of past self, nostalgic golden light, time loop atmosphere
genres.scene: 教学楼天台、空无一人的街道、雨；用 double exposure 表达叠加。
genres.gpt: Time loop anime illustration: a girl standing at the center of a shattered clock face while three faint translucent copies of herself repeat the same step nearby. Represent looping visually rather than explaining it, fractured numerals drifting in slow orbit, cracked glass radiating outward from her feet, and a cool temporal glow separating each duplicate from the next. Keep the real figure unmistakable through higher contrast and warmer color while the copies recede into cold transparency. Compose symmetrically with controlled chaos radiating from the center. Render numerals as shapes without readable text. No logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 时间循环题材的动画插画：同一条走廊上，同一个人物出现了三个重叠的半透明身影，分别处在不同的位置。这个题材的核心视觉是「同一时刻的多次出现」——身影用半透明处理并有轻微的残影，重叠处的饱和度累加。时间本身要有可见的痕迹：空气中悬浮的尘埃被拉成细线、墙上的钟停在同一个时间、水杯里的水面泛着不应有的涟漪。构图用横向的时间序列排列，让三个身影的移动方向清晰可读。配色用冷灰的底色加暖色的时间标识。整体安静、有宿命感、有思考的余地。画面不要文字、数字或水印。

genres.desc: 维多利亚时期的工业想象：黄铜齿轮、蒸汽、皮革护目镜、铆接结构。整体偏暖褐。
genres.demo: inventor girl with brass goggles, steampunk workshop, detailed copper gears, steam vents, warm sepia industrial light, victorian clothing
genres.scene: 砖砌工厂、飞艇码头、齿轮机械室；暖色 + 金属质感。
genres.gpt: Steampunk anime illustration: an engineer in heavy goggles working inside a brass boiler room thick with steam. Commit to the material rules, machined brass gearing showing real tooth counts through open inspection plates, riveted pressure vessels, copper piping running in believable service routes rather than decoration, and Victorian tailoring cut for actual labor. Add honest grime, coal soot streaking every vertical surface and oil sheen on the floor plates. Use a warm sepia and verdigris scheme lit by hanging filament bulbs. Compose a mid-shot gaining depth through successive arches of pipework. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 蒸汽朋克题材的动画插画：一名工匠站在钟楼的机械工坊里。视觉核心是「黄铜、齿轮与蒸汽」三件套，而且每一件都要有可信的机械关系：齿轮的齿数与咬合位置合理，管道有明确的走向与法兰接头，蒸汽从正确的缝隙里喷出。材质分档极其重要——抛光的黄铜有锐利的环境反射，皮革有磨损的哑光，玻璃管的油面会晃动。角色的装束是工匠式的：皮围裙、护目镜挂在额上、袖套磨旧。光线从高窗射入，被蒸汽切成一道道光柱。构图取中景，齿轮组占据背景。整体温暖、有重量、有机械的美感。画面不要文字、齿轮编号或水印。

genres.desc: 文明崩坏后的世界：自然重新接管建筑。强调「锈蚀 + 植被 + 独行者」。
genres.demo: lone traveler on overgrown highway, rusted car wrecks, vines reclaiming asphalt, hazy golden sunset, dust particles, melancholic mood
genres.scene: 废弃城市、荒野公路、被藤蔓覆盖的校舍；强烈夕照或雾。
genres.gpt: Post-apocalyptic anime illustration: two scavengers crossing a rusted highway overpass slowly reclaimed by tall grass. Sell environmental recovery rather than ruin cliche, the road surface split apart by tree roots, vehicle hulks half buried in weeds, oxidized corrugated steel, and dust haze flattening the horizon into pale layers. Give them mismatched repaired survival clothing instead of costume, with improvised packs and improvised water filters. Desaturate everything toward ochre and grey-green, and let sunlight arrive low, thick and dusty. Compose a wide frame with the humans deliberately small in it. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 末世废土题材的动画插画：一名幸存者站在废弃高速公路的中央。废土的可信度全靠「人造物的残骸」——护栏的断裂方式、废弃车辆被锈蚀到只剩骨架、路面被植物从裂缝里顶开。环境没有科幻的整洁，是真正的衰败。光线是黄昏的低角度斜射，尘埃在空气里形成体积光。色彩极低饱和：赭石、锈红、灰绿，唯一的鲜活色是人物身上的一点橙。构图的纵深靠公路的消失点。整体苍凉、寂静、有被时间遗忘的感觉。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 《学园默示录》一脉。核心张力在「日常的残骸」：破败校舍 + 制服幸存者。
genres.demo: two survivors in abandoned school hallway, tattered uniforms, glowing green spores drifting, cold desaturated light, barricade silhouettes
genres.scene: 封锁带、废弃校舍、夜里发光的孢子；低饱和冷色。
genres.gpt: Zombie outbreak anime illustration: a lone survivor moving through a quarantined street under cold blue emergency lighting. Build dread through restraint, plastic sheeting and cordon tape closing off the distance, bioluminescent spores drifting slowly through still air, the infected rendered as one undifferentiated mass silhouette beyond the barrier so no individual ever becomes legible, and a desaturated cold scheme broken only by one warm headlamp pool. Present contamination as physical change rather than gore. Compose a deep medium shot with heavy negative space overhead. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 生化感染题材的动画插画：一名幸存者站在废弃医院的走廊里，手电是唯一光源。感染的表现要具体而不是抽象：感染的部位有血管纹路的变化、体温造成的皮肤泛红、防护装备的破损位置。手电的光形成一道硬边光锥，照到的地方色彩鲜明，光锥之外迅速沉进深黑。走廊的构图用透视的纵深，把视线推向深处的门。环境的恐怖来自日常：翻倒的病床、散落的病历、被抓破的墙面。配色是病态的青绿与手电的暖白。整体压抑、有具体感、不血腥。画面不要文字、血字或水印。

genres.desc: 时间永远停在放学前的教室。必备元素：夕照教室、窗边座位、屋顶、单车、樱花。
genres.demo: student napping by classroom window, warm afternoon sunset light, long shadows, chalk dust floating, school uniform, nostalgic calm mood
genres.scene: 教室窗边 or 屋顶水塔；夕阳光 + 长影最有效。
genres.gpt: School life anime illustration: a student resting against a bicycle outside a classroom window on a spring afternoon. Aim for ordinary warmth rather than drama, a believable Japanese school uniform with correct collar piping and pleat count, sakura petals drifting across the open windows, scuffed wooden floor and worn desks visible inside, and low golden sunlight raking down the hallway. Keep expression small and genuinely unposed. Compose slightly off-center like a real captured moment, with foreground foliage partially occluding one edge. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 校园日常题材的动画插画：放学后的教室，只剩一名学生坐在靠窗的座位上。日常题材的可信度来自具体的道具：课桌上摊开的笔记本与笔袋、黑板上的板书残迹、椅背上挂着的布袋、窗外成排的樱花树。光线是傍晚的低角度斜阳，穿过窗户把长长的窗格影投在地板与课桌上，这是这个题材的标志性画面。人物姿态是放松的——单手托腮、椅子往后翘。构图的留白要多，课桌之间留出过道。配色用暖木色与白墙，配一点樱花的粉。整体安静、有温度、有放学后的松弛感。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 低信息密度、低对比、大量空镜与柔和光影。画面应该能「呼吸」。
genres.demo: girl reading in sunlit tatami room, cozy cluttered interior, soft diffused daylight, potted plants, warm relaxed atmosphere, wide quiet composition
genres.scene: 农村老家、咖啡店、被炉、雨 awning；自然光优先。
genres.gpt: Healing slice-of-life anime illustration: a young woman reading in a wooden cabin living room while rain tracks down the window beside her. Build it from small comforts, worn furniture carrying visible use marks, steam lifting from a kettle and a mug caught in the light, layered blankets, and books stacked on the floor rather than shelved neatly. Let soft north daylight do all the work with no harsh contrast anywhere, and keep the palette warm and low-saturation. Compose a wide quiet interior with generous negative space and no urgency. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 治愈慢生活题材的动画插画：一间面朝山谷的小屋，木桌上摆着刚煮好的早餐。治愈题材的成败在细节的舒适度：桌布有褶皱与使用痕迹，陶器有手作的不规则边缘，窗外是被晨雾软化的山脊线，蒸汽从杯口升起。光线是柔和的顺光，影子很浅，整幅画没有一处生硬的高对比。构图用广角，把窗外的景色与室内的静物一起收进来。配色用米白、原木与植物的绿，饱和度低。整体温暖、松弛、有想住进去的冲动。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 关键是「视线」与「距离」：对视、耳红、共享伞、指尖触碰。背景虚化。
genres.demo: two students sharing umbrella in rain, blushing eye contact, soft focus bokeh streetlights, pink cheeks, gentle romantic atmosphere
genres.scene: 樱花道、天台、烟花大会、车站；黄昏或夜晚最出味。
genres.gpt: Romance anime illustration: two students sharing one umbrella beneath cherry blossom trees at dusk. Build the scene on restraint rather than declaration, eye contact only half completed, one hand hesitating near a sleeve, blossom petals catching the streetlight, and rain reduced to fine legible streaks so nothing obscures the pair. Render faces with soft gradients and genuine blush rather than graphic marks. Dissolve everything behind them into gentle bokeh so the two separate cleanly from the world. Compose a medium two-shot with slight overhead tilt. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 恋爱与青春题材的动画插画：两名学生在放学后的车站站台上等车，彼此之间隔着一个人的距离。青春感来自「未完成感」：校服还穿着、书包还在肩上、话说了一半、眼神在躲开。画面要有明确的环境叙事——站台的长椅、远处的铁轨、被风吹起的落叶、开始变暗的天空。构图把两人分别放在画面的两侧，中间留出空隙，那段空隙就是关系本身。光线是逆光的暖调，把两人的轮廓镀上边。配色用暖橙与制服的藏蓝。整体青涩、有距离感、有张力。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 食物是 AI 出图最容易崩的题材之一。关键在高光：酱汁反光、蒸汽、食材纹理。
genres.demo: steaming bowl of ramen on wooden counter, glossy broth highlight, rising steam, warm lantern light, appetizing closeup angle, detailed ingredients
genres.scene: 木质厨桌、居酒屋、家庭厨房；暖光 + 浅景深。
genres.gpt: Food-focused anime illustration: a bowl of ramen mid-preparation lit eagerly from a three-quarter overhead angle. Prioritize appetite over literal accuracy, glossy broth carrying a convincing specular highlight with floating beads of rendered oil, steam rising in soft readable plumes, noodles drawn with individual strand definition rather than a mass, nori and narutomaki placed deliberately, and chashu showing real grain and rendered fat marbling. Add warm practical kitchen bokeh with hanging bulbs behind. Compose a tight forward-overhead shot with the bowl dominating frame and no human figures. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 美食料理题材的动画插画：一碗拉面摆在木桌上，热气升腾。美食题材的可信度在「食物的物理表现」——面条的粗细与卷曲方式要符合它被夹起来的状态，汤面要有油花的高光，肉片的横截面纹理要清楚，青菜要蔫而不是脆。蒸汽的画法要分层：近处的浓、远处的淡，并且有向上飘动的方向感。光线是侧逆光，让汤面的反光成为画面的焦点。构图是俯视稍偏的近景，背景虚化成暖色的餐厅环境。整体温热、有食欲、有生活感。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 《孤独摇滚》一类：舞台灯、乐器细节、飞散乐谱、观众剪影。重点是「光的颗粒感」。
genres.demo: guitarist mid-performance on small stage, sharp spotlights through haze, flying sheet music, crowd silhouettes below, energetic dynamic angle
genres.scene: Live House、天台排练；顶光 + 薄雾最出效果。
genres.gpt: Band performance anime illustration: a guitarist leaning back mid-solo on a small cramped stage. Stage it as a real gig, one hard spotlight rimming her out of the haze, colored backlights separating the band from the far wall, cable runs and pedalboards visible across worn stage floorboards, and coiled microphone stands awaiting their turn. Render the guitar correctly with the right string count and believable fret-hand reach. Reduce the crowd to a dark silhouette scattered with faint phone lights. Compose a wide energetic shot from stage level. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 音乐与乐队题材的动画插画：四名乐手在地下练习室里演出。声音的视觉化是这一题材的核心：鼓点让扬声器的网罩轻微形变、吉他的共鸣让音箱面板泛起涟漪、节拍在空气里画出可见的波纹。但人物的表演姿态必须真实——左手按弦的位置、发力的姿态、跟着节拍的晃动幅度。乐器的细节要准确：弦的数量与排列、鼓槌的握法、谱架的倾角。光线是舞台灯的定向彩光，但要有足够的环境光让乐器可辨认。构图取略仰的广角，把四个人的层次排开。整体有现场感、有热度。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 甜蜜感与华丽度拉到最大：荧光棒海洋、彩带、闪粉。色彩要饱和且明亮。
genres.demo: idol group on bright stage, colorful frilly costumes, confetti and glitter particles, crowd light sticks sea, cheerful expressions, vivid pop lighting
genres.scene: 舞台中央、车站广告牌、后台；多用彩虹色光斑与高光。
genres.gpt: Idol performance anime illustration: a solo idol mid-wave on a stadium stage under six converging spotlights. Build pure stage craft, a frilly costume designed to read from the cheapest seat with layered skirt volume and clear color blocking, glitter and confetti particles catching every individual beam, visible haze volumes giving each light a physical body, and a distant crowd rendered as a living carpet of raised glow sticks. Keep the expression genuinely joyful rather than smooth and vacant. Compose a wide low shot from below the stage lip. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 偶像与演艺题材的动画插画：一名偶像站在后台的化妆镜前。这个题材的画面张力在「幕后」——镜子里的妆面、衣架上挂着的演出服、桌上散落的手写歌词卡、还没来得及收起的麦克风架。台前的光与后台的光要分开处理：走廊尽头透进来的暖光是台前的，化妆镜的灯泡是冷白的，两种光在人物身上交界。人物的状态是有准备的疲惫——妆已画好，手还在抖。构图的视角是侧后方，能同时看到镜中的脸与真实的背影。整体有职业感、有幕后的重量。镜面上不要出现可读文字。画面不要水印。

genres.desc: 成年人的现实童话：西装、便利店夜光、末班车、堆积的文件。反差萌的来源。
genres.demo: tired office worker at cluttered desk late at night, blue monitor glow, empty coffee cups, city night through window, quiet melancholy
genres.scene: 办公室隔断、居酒屋、深夜电车；荧光灯的冷光。
genres.gpt: Working-adult anime illustration: an office worker standing alone in a late-night convenience store aisle under clinical fluorescent light. Ground it in observed detail, an ill-fitting suit with visible wear at both cuffs, a loosened tie, shoulder bag holding yesterday's desk clutter, and a paper coffee cup warming both hands. Let glass cooler doors and reflected security signage provide depth without readable characters anywhere. Set cold balanced white light against warm exhausted skin. Compose a medium shot using shelves for layered depth. No readable signage, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 职场题材的动画插画：一名上班族在深夜的办公室里独自加班。可信度来自职业细节：显示器上的表格轮廓（不要可读内容）、桌上凉掉的咖啡、堆叠的文件、桌上小盆栽的叶子有点蔫。疲惫的表现要克制——不是抱头喊叫，而是肩膀的塌陷与手停在键盘上方的静止。构图用高机位或平视，把大片空着的工位收进画面，用空旷强化孤独。光线只有屏幕的冷光与一盏没关的日光灯。配色用灰蓝与屏幕的冷白，唯一的暖是桌灯。整体疲惫、安静、有真实的加班感。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 《排球少年》《灌篮高手》《蓝色监狱》：汗珠、护具、球场地胶、飞扬尘土，强调肌肉线条与「决定性一瞬」。
genres.demo: volleyball player mid-spike above net, sweat droplets flying, indoor court with rim lights, dramatic low angle, motion blur on limbs, intense eyes
genres.scene: 体育馆（背光灯）+ 球场透视线；用 low angle + motion blur。
genres.gpt: Sports anime illustration: a sprinter exploding out of the blocks at the gun in an evening stadium. Render athletics honestly and then push it, accurate starting-block posture with one leg fully loaded and the opposite arm driving hard behind, correct jersey number fabric and a real track-shoe spike plate, individual sweat droplets caught mid-air off the jaw, and a low cloud of rubber dust being kicked off the track behind him. Compress the crowd into streaked background motion. Compose from a very low front-side angle. Keep the face focused rather than shouting. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 运动热血题材的动画插画：一名短跑运动员在塑胶跑道上冲过终点线，跨带正在被撞破。运动题材的表现力来自「身体的力学」——蹬地腿的肌肉拉伸、手臂的摆动幅度、重心前倾的角度、汗水飞散的方向都要符合真实的运动状态。赛道的透视是关键：分道线向消失点收，让速度感出来。镜头是低机位的侧向跟随，背景被拉出运动模糊。光线是户外正午的硬光，影子短而实。配色用跑道的赭红与天空的高饱和蓝。整体有爆发力、有汗水、有真实感。画面不要文字、号码布内容或水印。

genres.desc: 速度 = 拉伸的背景 + 车灯光轨 + 头盔倒影。《头文字 D》《MF Ghost》。
genres.demo: sports car drifting through mountain pass at night, motion blur, streaking headlight trails, helmet reflections, dynamic angle, energetic composition
genres.scene: 山道、夜隧道、环道；必须写 motion blur + light trails。
genres.gpt: Racing anime illustration: a driver in a full-face helmet threading a neon-lit tunnel at night. Sell velocity through optical truth rather than cartoon exaggeration, heavy directional motion blur across the tunnel walls while the car stays comparatively sharp, long light trails from the overhead striping, reflections sliding across the curved visor, and subtle body deformation in the panels under lateral load. Let the reflected tunnel bend visibly around the aerodynamics in the paint. Compose a low three-quarter shot with strong asymmetric framing and the wall whipping past. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 竞速与载具题材的动画插画：一辆赛车在山路的发卡弯中漂移过弯。速度的表现依赖三层东西：车身的姿态（车头指向弯心、后轮甩出）、环境的运动模糊（树影被拉成条状）、以及空气中的细微颗粒被卷起。车辆的结构要正确：尾翼的高度、排气管的位置、轮胎的扁平比与磨损。机车的画法不同——骑手的重心压到内侧、脚撑收起、身体与车形成一条线。构图用低机位与车道的引导线冲出画面。光线是斜射的低角度光，在车身上拉出一条连续的高光。整体有速度、有机械精度、有危险感。画面不要文字、赞助商标识或水印。

genres.desc: 皱巴巴的西装 / 风衣 + 暗街 + 雨天黑色电影光。构图爱用倾斜与百叶窗式的条纹投影。
genres.demo: detective in trench coat under streetlamp, harsh shadows across face, rain, noir city background, dutch angle, muted cool palette
genres.scene: 雨夜霓虹街、审讯室、旧馆library；低照度 + 单光源。
genres.gpt: Noir detective anime illustration: a raincoated investigator studying an evidence board in a shuttered dim office. Build the genre honestly, a heavy government-issue raincoat with water still beading across the shoulders, an evidence wall layered with pinned photographs and taut connecting string, a single desk lamp throwing the only warm light in the room, and harsh venetian-blind shadow cutting diagonally across every surface. Apply a slight dutch angle and strong value structure so shapes read as silhouette before they read as detail. Compose a medium shot with foreground occlusion. Render photographs without readable text. No logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 推理悬疑题材的动画插画：一名侦探站在雨夜的老宅书房里，手电照着墙上的一幅画。悬疑题材的关键是「证据的可读性」——线索必须真的画出来：被移动过的物品留下的痕迹、地毯上的脚印、桌上没收拾的茶杯、被翻动的书脊。光线只有手电这一个源，产生硬边光与长长的投影，房间的其余部分留在深暗里，但暗部必须保留可辨认的轮廓与细节，不能一片死黑。构图的视线要把观众引向那个还没被解释的角落。配色用深褐与冷蓝的手电光。整体克制、有疑点、不惊悚。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 日式恐怖靠氛围不靠血浆：违和的日常空间（阈限空间）、影子里的手、微妙失衡的比例。
genres.demo: empty school hallway at night, liminal space feeling, single flickering fluorescent tube, long unnatural shadow, film grain, dread atmosphere
genres.scene: 长廊、无人教室、深夜便利店；用 heavy grain 与低饱和。
genres.gpt: Horror anime illustration: a pale figure standing motionless at the far end of a dark tatami hallway at night. Keep the dread structural rather than graphic, negative space doing most of the work, shadows falling a few degrees wrong relative to the visible light source, subtle distortion in proportions the eye registers before the mind does, and grainy low-light texture concealing anything that would otherwise resolve. Use no gore, no blood and no jump-scare framing anywhere. Compose a deep one-point perspective with the figure small and unnaturally still. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 恐怖灵异题材的动画插画：一名女孩站在老宅的走廊尽头，身后是一扇半开的门。恐怖感的分寸是最难拿捏的：画得越血腥越廉价，正确做法是让「不对劲」停留在观察层面——走廊的地板有一块深色的痕迹、门框的漆皮翘起、墙上挂着两幅照片但其中一幅的画框朝向反了、灯只亮了一半。构图把人压在画面下方、留出大片未照亮的黑暗区域，让观众自己去发现。视线引导到那扇门，但门只开一半，看不清里面。配色是褪色的旧纸黄与深棕，只有一点冷白的光。整体安静、有压强、不靠血腥。画面不要文字或水印。

genres.desc: 近年兴起的网络怪谈美学：无限走廊、黄色荧光灯、模拟摄像机质感、略微出错的尺度感。
genres.demo: endless yellow office corridor, liminal space, buzzing fluorescent lights, worn carpet pattern, slightly wrong proportions, analog grain, unsettling
genres.scene: 黄褐色调的办公室、无限延伸的商场、VHS 画质；讲究「不合理空间」本身。
genres.gpt: Liminal backrooms horror illustration: a person standing in an endless office corridor under humming fluorescent light. Build discomfort entirely through correctness rather than monsters, mono-colored carpet and wallpaper repeating with no identifiable horizon, every door identical and every perspective line resolving very slightly wrong, proportions subtly too long for any real building, and no object doing anything unexpected. Render it as a degraded analog photograph with milky lifted shadows and soft chroma smear. Keep no creature visible anywhere in frame. Compose dead-center symmetric with deep recession. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 都市怪谈题材的动画插画：一名上班族在加班后走过城市的地下通道，尽头是平常绝不会有的那家店。怪谈的视觉核心是「日常里的一个缺口」——通道的瓷砖有一段拼错了、店门口的菜单牌上有现实的菜品但价格是旧的、店里只有一位客人且背对着门。整体环境要画得完全真实、现代化，如果环境不够日常，怪异就无从成立。光线是通道灯管的惨白与店内暖灯的对比，两种色温的分界正好在门框上。构图的视角是过肩，让观众与角色看到同一个东西。整体真实、有冷感、有说不清的异样。招牌与菜单上的字不要可读。画面不要水印。

genres.desc: 国创主力题材：汉服、飞剑、符箓。独特之处在于「留白 + 云海 + 山水」的东方空间观，而不像西幻那样把画面填满。
genres.demo: cultivator standing on cloud sea peak, flowing white hanfu, flying sword beside, distant mountain ranges in mist, ink-influenced palette, epic vertical composition
genres.scene: 云海山巅、竹林、宫殿飞檐；建议配合水墨感与留白构图。
genres.gpt: Xianxia wuxia illustration: a cultivator riding a flying sword above a sea of cloud between jade mountain peaks. Hold to the regional vocabulary, layered hanfu with wide sleeves streaming in the altitude wind, the blade rendered fine and straight rather than as a fantasy broadsword, mountain forms drawn with vertical Chinese landscape logic instead of photographic geology, drifting mist handled as genuine negative space, and visible ink-wash influence throughout the far distance. Add a faint daoist talisman glow along the blade edge. Compose a vertical frame with enormous sky above. No text, logos or watermarks.
genres.gptZh: 仙侠武侠国风题材的动画插画：一名持剑侠客站在云海之上的山峰之巅，长袍被风吹起。国风武侠的美学要点在「留白与气韵」：云海要占画面大面积，用极淡的渲染表现层次；山体用墨线的骨法交代结构而不追求体积；人物的衣纹要长而飘，走动时有延迟的飘动。兵器与配饰有考据感——剑鞘的纹样、发冠的形制、腰佩的玉。构图用三段式：侠客在画面下方三分之一处，云海在中，山峰剪影在上。配色用水墨的墨色与极少的青绿、赭黄点睛。整体有气韵、有留白、有中国美学的骨架。画面不要文字或水印。

layouts.desc: 上半部整块画面，下半部整块文字，中间留一条明确分界。适合金句、观点、结论先行的小红书图。
layouts.note: 文字占比不要超过画面 40%，否则模型会把字画糊；正文要短
layouts.demo: vertical poster layout, illustration occupying the upper two thirds, clean text block below, generous margins, single strong focal subject
layouts.gpt: Social card in a strict top-bottom split: the upper two thirds carry one full illustration with a single strong focal subject, the lower third is reserved as a clean empty band for a short line of text. Separate the two zones with whitespace rather than a hard rule, keep the margins wide on all four sides, and leave every text area as flat empty ground so the type stays crisp. Do not letter anything; the space is reserved, not filled.
layouts.gptZh: 严格上下分栏的社媒卡：上方三分之二是一整幅插画，只有一个明确的主体；下方三分之一留成干净的空白带，专门放一行短文字。两个区域用留白分隔而不是画一条硬线，四边留足页边距，所有文字区保持为空底，方便后期排字。画面里不要写任何字，那块空白是预留的，不是要填满的。

layouts.desc: 背景近乎空白，一个极简元素点缀，大面积留给文字。适合金句、语录、态度表达。
layouts.note: 极简版式对模型最友好——元素越少越不容易出错，也最不容易出废图
layouts.demo: minimal quote card, almost entirely empty background, vast clean negative space, one small subtle accent element in a corner, extremely low visual detail
layouts.gpt: Copy-led card. The background is almost entirely empty — a calm flat field with no imagery competing for attention. Place one small, restrained accent element off-center near a corner: a single brush mark, a thin rule, one leaf. Keep total visual information extremely low so that a headline can occupy the middle third without fighting anything. No lettering, no watermark.
layouts.gptZh: 文案主导的卡片。背景几乎全空，只是一片平静的纯色底，不要有具体物象跟文字抢注意力。在偏心的角落放一个克制的小点缀元素——一笔笔触、一条细线、一片叶子。整体视觉信息量压到极低，让主标题能占据中间三分之一而不打架。画面里不要写字，不要水印。

layouts.desc: 画面竖直一分为二，左右各一个内容，用于对比、前后、两种做法。
layouts.note: 两个主体的画风、景别、光线必须一致，否则模型会当成两张不同的画
layouts.demo: vertical split layout, two panels side by side of equal width, matching style and lighting across both halves, thin gutter between them, comparative diptych
layouts.gpt: A side-by-side diptych divided by a single thin vertical gutter. Both halves must share one identical style, one identical lighting direction, one identical camera height and one identical scale — the only thing that differs is the subject on each side. Keep the two halves tonally balanced so neither reads as more important. Do not letter either panel.
layouts.gptZh: 左右对照的对照式构图，用一条细竖缝分成两半。两边必须是完全一致的画风、完全一致的光线方向、完全一致的机位高度和完全一致的尺度，唯一的差别是各自的主体。两个区域的影调要平衡，不要让任何一边显得更重要。两边都不要写字。

layouts.desc: 主体偏置，某个角落留出固定位置放署名或账号。适合个人 IP 的固定图型。
layouts.note: 留空位置要写进提示词，否则模型会自己写一个假签名上去
layouts.demo: portrait-oriented card with the subject pushed off-center, one corner deliberately left empty as a reserved signature space, calm flat background, generous margins
layouts.gpt: A card with the subject pushed off-center so that one corner falls free. Treat that corner as a deliberately reserved signature space — keep it as clean flat ground and do not let the illustration drift into it. The rest of the frame stays calm and open. Do not render a name, initials or any lettering; the space is held open on purpose.
layouts.gptZh: 主体偏置的卡片，留出一个角作为预留的署名位。把那个角当成刻意留空的地方，保持干净的空底，不要让画面元素漂进去。其余部分保持平静开阔。不要渲染姓名、缩写或任何文字，那块空间是故意留着的。

layouts.desc: 画面顶天立地铺满，不留任何边框。适合手机全屏浏览的短视频封面。
layouts.note: 满出血构图里主体必须偏离正中心，否则裁切时会正好切到脸
layouts.demo: full bleed vertical composition, artwork running edge to edge with no border or margin, immersive atmosphere, subject placed off-center to survive cropping
layouts.gpt: A full-bleed vertical composition: the artwork runs edge to edge with no border, no frame and no margin anywhere. Place the subject well off-centre so the image survives cropping to different aspect ratios. Let the atmosphere carry the image rather than a single hard focal point. No text, no watermark, no border line.
layouts.gptZh: 满出血的竖幅构图：画面顶天立地铺满，四边没有边框、没有留白、没有边线。主体要明显偏离正中心，这样裁成不同比例时才不会被切到脸。让氛围撑起画面，而不是靠一个生硬的视觉焦点。不要文字，不要水印，不要描边。

layouts.desc: 极窄的竖长条，内容自上而下堆叠。适合手机滚动阅读的信息流。
layouts.note: 元素要按从上到下的顺序排，读起来才是一条线而不是一堆散块
layouts.demo: tall narrow vertical strip, content stacked top to bottom in clear reading order, narrow format, repeated rhythm, low width-to-height ratio
layouts.gpt: A tall narrow vertical strip designed for a scrolling phone feed. Stack the content from top to bottom in an unambiguous reading order, repeating one visual rhythm across the strip so the eye travels downward without interruption. Keep the width-to-height ratio extreme. Do not letter anything.
layouts.gptZh: 为手机滚动信息流设计的极窄竖长条。内容自上而下堆叠，阅读顺序必须毫无歧义，整条重复同一个视觉节奏，让视线能顺畅地往下走而不被打断。宽高比要极端。不要写任何文字。

layouts.desc: 自上而下三层或四层的金字塔，用来表达「上位概念包含下位概念」。
layouts.note: 层数别超过四层，再多就读不出来了；层宽差要明显
layouts.demo: clean pyramid infographic diagram, three clearly separated stacked tiers, each tier visibly wider than the one above, flat solid fills, generous spacing between levels, minimal decoration
layouts.gpt: A clean pyramid infographic with three clearly separated stacked tiers. Each tier must be visibly wider than the one above so the hierarchy reads instantly. Use flat solid fills with clear edges and generous spacing between levels; drop shadows, gradients and 3D bevels all fight the clarity a diagram needs. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 干净的金字塔信息图，分成三层清晰隔开的层级。每一层要比上一层明显更宽，让层级关系一眼就读出来。用纯色平涂配清晰的边缘，层与层之间留足间距；阴影、渐变、立体斜角全都会削弱图示需要的清晰度。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 中心一个主体，四周引出标注线指向各部分。适合解剖、构成、部件说明。
layouts.note: 标注线要与主体真实相交，不能凭空连到空气里
layouts.demo: annotated infographic with one large central figure, thin leader lines radiating outward to empty label positions around it, clean flat background, precise technical illustration feel
layouts.gpt: An annotated infographic built around one large central figure. Thin leader lines radiate outward from real parts of that figure to empty label positions placed in the surrounding margin. Every line must terminate on something that is actually in the drawing. Keep the background flat and uncluttered and give the whole thing a precise technical-illustration feel. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 以一个大主体为核心的标注式信息图。细引线从主体的真实部位出发，指向四周留好的空白标签位。每一根线都必须落在图里真实存在的东西上。背景保持干净不杂，整体带精确的技术插画感。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 多行多列的网格，每格一个单元。适合清单、参数、选项对比。
layouts.note: 格子之间留白要一致，格子大小不一致会让画面显得乱
layouts.demo: multi column comparison layout, evenly spaced row grid, uniform cell sizes, consistent internal padding, flat distinct fills per row, structured and even
layouts.gpt: A multi-column comparison laid out as evenly spaced rows. Every cell must be the same size and share the same internal padding, because mismatched cells read as sloppiness rather than variety. Use one flat distinct fill per row, keep the gutters generous and uniform, and let the structure carry the layout with no ornament. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 多列对比布局，排成间距均匀的若干行。每个格子必须同样大小、内部留白一致——格子不统一会显得潦草，而不是显得多样。每一行用一种平涂色块，留足且统一的间隙，让结构本身撑起版面，不加任何装饰。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 横向从左到右的节点串联。适合步骤、流程、演进过程。
layouts.note: 节点数量控制在 5 个以内，再多连线会交叉成乱麻
layouts.demo: horizontal timeline infographic, four evenly spaced milestone nodes connected left to right, one clear directional flow, flat shapes, consistent node sizing, uncluttered
layouts.gpt: A horizontal timeline infographic with four evenly spaced milestone nodes connected left to right. Keep one unambiguous direction of travel, size every node identically, and route the connectors so they never cross. Flat shapes, consistent spacing, nothing decorative competing with the sequence. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 横向时间轴信息图，四个等距的里程碑节点从左到右连接。保持一个不含糊的流向，每个节点同样大小，连接线要走成不交叉的路线。用平涂形状，间距一致，不放任何跟序列抢注意力的装饰。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 步骤式纵向排布，每一步一个独立小画面。适合教程、做法、指南。
layouts.note: 每一步要能独立看懂，不能依赖上一步才成立
layouts.demo: vertical step-by-step instructional layout, four equal stacked stages each self-contained, repeated identical framing per step, clear top to bottom progression
layouts.gpt: A vertical step-by-step instructional layout with four equal stacked stages, each one complete and legible on its own. Repeat the identical framing, scale and lighting in every stage so the reader sees the same subject changing rather than four different images. Keep the progression strictly top to bottom. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 纵向的分步教程布局，四个等大的独立阶段，每一步都能独立看懂。每一步重复完全相同的取景、尺度与光线，让读者看到的是同一个东西在变化，而不是四张不同的图。顺序严格自上而下。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 照片、明信片、便签、胶带层层叠贴。适合清单、旅行、生活记录。
layouts.note: 每个元素要有明确边界，不要糊成一团；胶带要半透明才像真的贴上去
layouts.demo: journal scrapbook collage, several small rectangular paper elements layered with slight rotation, visible translucent tape strips, thin photo borders, warm off-white paper background
layouts.gpt: A journal scrapbook collage: several small rectangular paper elements layered with slight individual rotation, held by visible strips of translucent tape that let the paper beneath show through. Give each element a crisp thin border so it stays legible as a separate piece. Warm off-white paper background. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 手帐拼贴风：几块小矩形纸片各自略微旋转地叠在一起，用半透明胶带固定，胶带要能透出下面的纸。每一块都要有清晰细边框，让它作为独立元素读得出来。背景是温暖的米白纸色。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 四格等分，顺序推进，最经典的漫画格式。
layouts.note: 四格之间要有明确留白沟槽，格子贴一起会分不清边界
layouts.demo: four panel comic strip, equal rectangular panels in clear left-to-right reading order, generous white gutters between panels, clean black panel borders, consistent style across all four
layouts.gpt: A four-panel comic strip with equal rectangular panels read left to right. Leave generous white gutters so each panel reads as a separate beat. Use clean black panel borders of identical weight, and hold one identical style, line weight and character design across all four panels so only the action changes. Leave speech balloons empty or absent. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 四格漫画，格子等大，从左到右阅读。留足白色沟槽，让每一格读起来是一个独立节拍。用粗细一致的干净黑框，四个格子保持完全相同的画风、线重与角色设定，只有动作在变。对白框留空或干脆不要。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 四格分别承担铺垫、发展、转折、收束，读完是一个完整小故事。
layouts.note: 转折格要跟前两格明显不同，一眼能看出转折点在哪
layouts.demo: four panel narrative strip with a clear arc, calm setup panel then rising panel then a sharp turn panel then a resolution panel, escalating drama, consistent character design
layouts.gpt: A four-panel narrative strip carrying a complete arc: panel one calm and establishing, panel two rising, panel three a sharp visual turn that could not be predicted from panel two, panel four a resolution that resolves what panel three opened. Keep the character design identical across all four so only staging, scale and expression change. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 四格叙事条，承载一个完整弧线：第一格平静铺陈，第二格升温，第三格是一个从第二格无法预测的急转，第四格收束第三格打开的悬念。四格角色设定必须完全一致，变化的只有调度、尺度与表情。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 用斜线把画面切开，两侧内容不同。适合表现对立、速度、失衡。
layouts.note: 斜切后两侧的地面透视要一致，否则会像两张图硬拼
layouts.demo: diagonally split panel layout, one strong angled division running corner to corner, contrasting content on each side, shared ground plane and lighting across the divide
layouts.gpt: A diagonally split panel with one strong angled division running corner to corner, contrasting content on each side. Crucially, both sides must share the same ground plane, the same lighting direction and the same rendering style — otherwise the split reads as two unrelated images pasted together rather than one dynamic frame. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 斜切式分镜，用一道从角到角的强斜线切开分出对比内容。关键是两侧必须共用同一地面透视、同一光线方向、同一渲染风格——否则那道斜线会让画面读成两张无关图硬拼，而不是一个动态的单帧。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 一整幅不切分的画面，承担整页的高潮时刻。适合名场面、情绪爆点。
layouts.note: 不分割意味着细节要求更高，出图后要在后期加网点或留白强化戏剧感
layouts.demo: single full-bleed splash panel, one unbroken dramatic moment filling the entire frame, high impact moment, cinematic still, no internal borders, strong focal subject
layouts.gpt: A single full-bleed splash panel: one unbroken dramatic moment filling the entire frame with no internal borders anywhere. Concentrate the action at one clear focal point and let the surrounding energy radiate outward from it. Because nothing is subdivided, the whole image can carry one continuous atmosphere. No lettering, no speech balloons.
layouts.gptZh: 单幅满出血大格：一整页不切分的戏剧瞬间铺满画面，内部没有任何分格。把动作集中在一个明确的焦点上，让周围的能量从那里向外扩散。正因为不分割，整幅图能承载一个连贯的氛围。不要写字，不要对白框。

layouts.desc: 同一构图重复多次，情绪逐格增强。适合表现积累到爆发的过程。
layouts.note: 构图必须一样，只有表情/姿态变，否则递进关系不成立
layouts.demo: four repeating identical frames escalating in intensity, same composition each time, progressive increase in drama, locked camera position, one variable changing per frame
layouts.gpt: Four frames repeating the identical composition while escalating in intensity. Lock the camera position, framing and subject placement exactly the same in each, and let only one variable change per frame — expression, then posture, then lighting, then scale. Because everything else stays fixed, the escalation becomes unmistakable. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 四帧重复完全相同的构图，强度逐级上升。机位、取景、主体位置在每一帧里严格锁定，每帧只改变一个变量——先表情，再姿态，再光线，再尺度。正因为其他一切不变，递进关系才不容置疑。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 密集小格网，每格一个片段，整体形成节奏与密度。适合表现量、时间跨度、群像。
layouts.note: 格子多了容易出现人物漂移，同一个人要在多格里保持一致
layouts.demo: dense grid montage, twelve equal small panels in even rows and columns, one continuous subject matter across all cells, rhythmic visual variety, consistent style throughout
layouts.gpt: A dense grid montage of twelve equal small panels arranged in even rows and columns. Keep one continuous subject matter across all cells so they read as fragments of the same thing, not twelve unrelated images. Vary the framing within each cell for rhythm, but hold the style constant. No lettering in any cell.
layouts.gptZh: 十二个小格均匀排成行列的密集蒙太奇。所有格子保持同一个连续的题材内容，让它们读起来是同一件事的碎片，而不是十二张无关的图。每格内部变换取景来形成节奏，但画风保持一致。任何一格都不要写字。

layouts.desc: 正面、侧面、背面三视图并列。适合角色设定、标准件。
layouts.note: 三视图必须用正交视角，不能有透视变形，否则建模会崩
layouts.demo: character turnaround model sheet, front side and back views aligned in a row, orthographic projection with no perspective distortion, identical proportions and scale across views, plain neutral background
layouts.gpt: A character turnaround model sheet showing front, side and back views aligned in one row on a plain neutral background. Use orthographic projection throughout — any perspective distortion breaks the purpose of a turnaround. Every view must share identical proportions, identical scale, identical height and identical costume detail. No lettering, no labels.
layouts.gptZh: 角色三视图设定图，在纯净中性背景上把正面、侧面、背面排成一行。整张用正交投影——任何透视变形都会让三视图失去作用。三个视角必须共用完全一致的比例、尺度、身高与服装细节。不要写字，不要标注。

layouts.desc: 同一张脸的多格表情差分。适合角色资产、表情包生产。
layouts.note: 头部角度要固定，只变表情；否则模型会连头型一起改
layouts.demo: character expression sheet, eight head studies in a neat grid, identical head angle and identical face proportions in every cell, only the expression changes, clean flat background
layouts.gpt: A character expression sheet with eight head studies in a neat grid. Lock the head angle, the face proportions, the line weight and the hair silhouette identically in every cell so that the only thing changing is the expression itself. Clean flat background, even spacing, no lettering or emotion labels.
layouts.gptZh: 角色表情差分表，八个头部特写在规整网格里排列。每一格锁定相同的头部角度、脸部比例、线重与发型轮廓，保证变化的只有表情本身。背景干净平坦，间距均匀，不要写字或情绪标签。

layouts.desc: 吉祥物的主视觉 + 多角度 + 要素拆解。适合品牌与衍生周边。
layouts.note: 剪影要能单独认出来——缩到指甲盖大小还认得出才算合格
layouts.demo: mascot character specification sheet, one large hero pose plus two smaller supporting views, distinct readable silhouette, simplified bold shapes, plain flat background, commercial character design clarity
layouts.gpt: A mascot character specification sheet: one large hero pose plus two smaller supporting views on a plain flat background. The silhouette must stay distinct and readable when shrunk small — that is the real test of a mascot. Simplify the shapes into bold confident forms and keep every view consistent with the hero pose. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 吉祥物角色设定页：在纯净平底上一个大号主姿态加两个较小的辅助视角。剪影必须在小尺寸下依然清晰可辨——这才是检验吉祥物是否成立的标准。把形状简化成大胆有力的块面，所有视角与主姿态保持一致。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 材质样、色块、纹理拼贴成情绪板。适合定调、提案。
layouts.note: 色块要给出可用的十六进制值，否则无法落地到具体设计
layouts.demo: visual mood board, flat color swatches and small texture samples arranged in a loose grid, limited cohesive palette, material references, tactile surface detail
layouts.gpt: A visual mood board: flat color swatches and small texture samples arranged in a loose grid, held together by one limited cohesive palette. Include tactile material references — a paper edge, a fabric weave, a metal sheen — so the board communicates surface quality and not just hue. Keep the arrangement informal and breathing. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 视觉情绪板：平涂色块与小尺寸纹理样本松散排布在网格里，用一套受限且协调的配色把它们统住。要包含材质参照——一道纸边、一段织物纹理、一处金属光泽——让情绪板传达表面质感而不只是色相。排布要随意、有呼吸感。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 单一商品居中，背景干净。适合电商主图与详情页首图。
layouts.note: 背景不能纯白到失去轮廓，要有一点层次让商品边界清楚
layouts.demo: single product centered on a clean graduated backdrop, controlled studio lighting with one clear key light and soft fill, sharp product edges, generous even margins, e-commerce main image quality
layouts.gpt: A single product centered on a clean graduated backdrop under controlled studio lighting — one clear key light plus soft fill so the form reads without harsh shadow. Keep the background light enough to feel bright but not so flat that the product loses its silhouette. Preserve sharp product edges and leave generous, even margins. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 单一商品居中于干净渐变背景上，用可控的影棚布光——一个明确的主光加柔和补光，让形体读得出来又不产生生硬阴影。背景要够亮但不能平到让商品失去轮廓。保持商品边缘锐利，四周留足均匀的页边距。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 同一商品多个角度并列。适合需要看细节的商品。
layouts.note: 多视角之间商品的相对大小要一致，否则看起来像不同商品
layouts.demo: multiple angle catalog view of one product, four viewpoints arranged in even columns, identical scale and lighting across all views, seamless clean background
layouts.gpt: A multiple-angle catalog view of one product: four viewpoints arranged in even columns on a seamless clean background. Every view must share identical scale and identical lighting so they read as the same object rather than four different products. Align the baselines across views so the arrangement looks deliberate. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 同一商品的多视角目录图：四个视角均匀排成列，背景无缝干净。每个视角必须共用相同尺度与相同光线，读起来是同一个东西而不是四个不同商品。把各视角的基线对齐，让排布显得是刻意安排的。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 商品局部放大 + 指示标注。适合讲卖点、材质、参数。
layouts.note: 标注线要指向真正想说的那个细节，不能乱指
layouts.demo: product feature callout diagram, one enlarged detail region as the focus, thin leader lines pointing from real structural details to empty label positions, context shot kept smaller, clean flat background
layouts.gpt: A product feature callout diagram. One enlarged detail region is the focus; thin leader lines run from genuine structural details inside that region to empty label positions around the margin. Keep a smaller context view so the reader knows where the detail came from. Precise and technical, never decorative. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 商品卖点标注图。一处放大的细节区域作为焦点，细引线从该区域内真实的结构细节出发，指向四周留好的空白标签位。旁边保留一个较小的上下文视图，让读者知道这个细节来自哪里。整体精确、技术性，不要装饰感。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 商品放在真实使用环境里。适合建立使用欲望而非陈列参数。
layouts.note: 环境要真的像有人用，而不是把商品 P 到风景上
layouts.demo: lifestyle context shot, the product naturally in use within a believable lived-in environment, human presence implied rather than staged, warm natural light, candid composition
layouts.gpt: A lifestyle context shot with the product naturally in use inside a believable, lived-in environment. Imply human presence — a hand, a seat, a cup left behind — rather than staging a model. Use warm natural light and a candid, slightly unposed composition. The goal is to make the reader want the product, not to list its specifications. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 使用场景图：商品自然地使用在一个可信的、有人生活过的环境里。要暗示人的存在——一只手、一把坐过的椅子、一只喝剩的杯——而不是摆拍一个模特。用温暖的自然光和略带随手感、没有刻意摆好的构图。目标是让读者想要这个商品，而不是罗列参数。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 画面为一个大标题服务，标题区占显著位置。适合公众号、博客封面。
layouts.note: 标题留空区必须干净，模型很容易在留空处自己写字
layouts.demo: editorial poster cover with one bold focal image and a large clearly reserved headline area, strong visual hierarchy, flat clean zone for type, dramatic composition
layouts.gpt: An editorial poster cover built around one bold focal image plus a large, clearly reserved headline area. The type zone must stay a clean flat field — models fill empty space with invented lettering, so state that the space is reserved and remain unlettered. Keep one dominant focal point and let it carry the hierarchy. No text.
layouts.gptZh: 一张围绕「一个大视觉焦点 + 一块明确预留的大标题区」构建的编辑类封面。文字区必须保持干净的平底——模型会往空白处自己写字，所以要明确声明这块空间是预留的，保持不写字。维持一个主导焦点，让它撑起视觉层级。不要文字。

layouts.desc: 用一个具象画面表达一个抽象概念。适合观点、趋势、思考类封面。
layouts.note: 隐喻要能从画面直接读出来，不要设计成需要解释的谜语
layouts.demo: conceptual cover using one literal image to stand for an abstract idea, clear symbolic relationship, single strong metaphor, restrained composition, dramatic scale contrast
layouts.gpt: A conceptual cover that uses one literal, concrete image to stand for an abstract idea. The symbolic relationship must be readable immediately without explanation — build it through scale contrast, repetition or an unexpected material pairing rather than through allegory. Keep the composition restrained with one dominant element. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 一张用单一具象画面表达抽象概念的封面。象征关系必须一眼可读、不需要解释——靠尺度对比、重复出现或出意料的材质搭配来建立，而不是靠寓言。构图保持克制，以一个主导元素为中心。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 靠强烈对比抓注意力：尺度、密度、明暗或色温的极端反差。
layouts.note: 对比只在两个元素之间成立，元素多了互相削弱就没有冲击力了
layouts.demo: high contrast cover built on one extreme juxtaposition, vast scale difference between two elements, stark tonal contrast, minimal supporting detail, immediate visual impact
layouts.gpt: A high-contrast cover built on one extreme juxtaposition — a vast difference in scale, a stark tonal split, or an opposing temperature. Contrast only works between two elements; add a third and they weaken each other into mush. Keep supporting detail minimal so the opposition reads instantly at thumbnail size. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 靠一组极端并置建立的高对比封面：巨大的尺度差、硬性的影调分割，或对立的色温。对比只在两个元素之间成立——加入第三个，它们就会互相削弱成一团。把辅助细节压到最少，让这种对立在缩略图尺寸下也能立刻读出来。不要写字。

layouts.desc: 竖版、有氛围铺陈的画面。适合短篇、章节开场、竖屏内容。
layouts.note: 竖版画面上下跨度大，主体要放在中段，避免被裁掉
layouts.demo: vertical narrative cover with atmospheric depth, layered recession from foreground to distance, subject placed in the middle vertical third, cinematic lighting, portrait orientation
layouts.gpt: A vertical narrative cover with real atmospheric depth: build layers receding from foreground to distance so the eye travels inward. Place the subject in the middle vertical third, because a portrait frame gives you far more vertical room than horizontal and an off-centre subject will be cropped. Cinematic lighting, portrait orientation. No lettering.
layouts.gptZh: 有真实空气纵深的竖版叙事封面：从前景到远景层层递进，让视线向内走。主体放在竖向中段三分之一处——竖画幅给的纵向空间远大于横向，主体偏中心就会被裁掉。用电影感光线，竖构图。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 沉稳、可信、有说服力。科技、金融、工具类内容的默认色。
palettes.desc: 一种饱和度较高的正蓝作为画面主导色，其余全部压到接近无彩。最常见的专业感配色。
palettes.note: 蓝主导时肤色会偏冷，需要一点暖光或暖色点缀救回来，否则人物显得像塑料
palettes.demo: classic blue palette, deep saturated blue as the dominant color, near-neutral desaturated surroundings, one warm accent for contrast, clean studio lighting
palettes.gpt: A classic blue palette: one deep, saturated blue carries the entire image while everything around it is pulled down to near-neutral, nearly colorless. Keep exactly one warm accent small and deliberate so the blue has something to push against. Because a blue-dominant scene cools every skin tone in it, add a subtle warm rim or warm practical light so figures do not turn plastic. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 经典蓝配色：用一个深而饱和的蓝撑起整幅画面，周围一切都被压到接近无彩的近中性色。只留一个暖色点缀，小而刻意，让这个蓝有可以对照的东西。因为蓝色主导会给整个场景的肤色降温，要加一点微妙的暖轮廓光或暖实用光源，否则人物会显得像塑料。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 温热、有食欲、有人味。适合生活、美食、节气、故事。
palettes.desc: 偏红的暖橙作主导，配奶油白或土黄做底。是最不容易出错的暖色方案。
palettes.note: 橙色主导时务必留一块低饱和的底色，否则整幅画面会吵
palettes.demo: persimmon orange palette, warm red-leaning orange dominating, cream and earthy tan supporting tones, soft warm light, cozy approachable mood
palettes.gpt: A persimmon orange palette with a red-leaning warm orange as the dominant, supported by cream and earthy tan. Keep one clearly lower-saturation area in the frame so the orange has somewhere to breathe — fully saturated orange everywhere reads as noise. Soft warm light, cozy and approachable. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 柿子橙配色：以偏红的暖橙为主导，配奶油白与土黄辅助。画面里要保留一块明确低饱和度的区域，让这个橙有喘息的地方——处处满饱和的橙读起来是噪音。用柔和暖光，氛围温馨亲近。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 安静、自然、不刺激。适合护肤、家居、植物、疗愈。
palettes.desc: 带灰的低饱和绿，自带安静气质。是最不容易出错的高级感配色之一。
palettes.note: 低饱和意味着对比弱，必须靠明度拉开层次，否则画面会糊成一片
palettes.demo: sage green palette, muted grey-leaning green, low saturation natural tones, soft cream neutrals, gentle diffuse light, calm understated elegance
palettes.gpt: A sage green palette: a muted, grey-leaning green at low saturation, grounded in soft cream neutrals, lit by gentle diffuse light. Because the saturation is low, the image must be structured by value contrast rather than by hue — separate every layer with a clear step in lightness, or the whole frame will flatten into one mass. Calm, understated elegance. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 鼠尾草绿配色：偏灰的低饱和绿，落在柔和奶油中性色上，用温和的漫射光照明。因为饱和度低，画面必须靠明度对比而不是靠色相来建立结构——每一层之间要有清晰的亮度台阶，否则整幅会摊成一团。安静、不张扬的高级感。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 厚重、考究、有收藏感。适合经典、复古、文艺、历史。
palettes.desc: 极深的蓝黑，配一点点暗金或旧纸色。有博物馆与古籍的质感。
palettes.note: 深色主导时要留一处亮，否则整幅会闷成一团黑
palettes.demo: prussian blue palette, very deep dark teal blue dominant, muted antique gold accent, aged paper undertones, dramatic low-key lighting, scholarly classic mood
palettes.gpt: A Prussian blue palette: a very deep, dark teal-leaning blue dominates, lifted by a muted antique gold accent and the faintest undertone of aged paper. Low-key dramatic lighting. Because such a dark scheme swallows detail, place exactly one small bright element in the frame to give the eye a place to land and to stop the image from going muddy. Scholarly, classic, collected. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 普鲁士蓝配色：极深的、偏青的暗蓝占主导，用一点哑光的古金提亮，并带最淡的陈纸底色。用低调的戏剧性布光。因为这么深的调子会吞掉细节，画面里要恰好放一个小的亮元素，给眼睛一个落点，避免整幅糊成一片。考究、经典、有收藏感。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 强烈、有主张、有攻击性。适合节庆、促销、态度表达。
palettes.desc: 高饱和的正红作为唯一主角，其他全部退成中性灰或黑。
palettes.note: 红色是高风险主色，用错会显得廉价；饱和度宁低勿高
palettes.demo: rouge red palette, saturated crimson as the single dominant color, everything else pulled to deep neutral grey and near-black, one restrained contrast, assertive mood
palettes.gpt: A rouge red palette with a saturated crimson as the single dominant color, and everything else pulled back to deep neutral grey or near-black. Red is a high-risk dominant: if it is too bright or too saturated the whole image reads as cheap. Err on the side of slightly lower saturation, and hold the accent areas restrained. Assertive, opinionated. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 胭脂红配色：高饱和的深红作为唯一主导色，其余一切退到深中性灰或近黑。红是高风险主色，太亮或太饱和整幅就会读成廉价。宁可比标准稍低饱和一点，点缀区也要克制。有主张、有攻击性。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 明亮、温和、有食欲。适合儿童、餐饮、春天、日系生活。
palettes.desc: 柔和的暖黄打底，配焦糖色。可爱但不腻，是日系生活画的常用底色。
palettes.note: 黄色本身亮度高，主体需要用深色轮廓压住，否则会糊
palettes.demo: cream yellow palette, soft warm pale yellow dominating, caramel brown accent, gentle warm daylight, bright friendly approachable mood
palettes.gpt: A cream yellow palette: a soft warm pale yellow dominates, grounded by a caramel brown accent under gentle warm daylight. Because yellow is intrinsically high in value, every subject needs a darker contour or a deeper shadow somewhere to keep the forms from washing into the background. Bright, friendly and approachable without turning cloying. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 奶油黄配色：柔和的暖调淡黄占主导，用焦糖棕压住，在温暖日光下成立。因为黄色本身明度就高，每个主体都必须有一处更深的轮廓或更重的暗部，才能把形体从背景里压出来。明亮、友好、亲近，又不腻。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 奢侈、庄重、有仪式感。适合美妆、腕表、黑金主题。
palettes.desc: 接近纯黑的底色，只有金属高光与金调点缀。高级感最强的组合之一。
palettes.note: 黑底要把高光做够，否则材质会看不出区别；金属件要有一处明确反射
palettes.demo: ink black and gold palette, near black dominant, metallic gold accent with crisp specular highlights, dramatic single key light, luxurious elegant mood
palettes.gpt: An ink-black-and-gold palette: a near-black ground carries the image and metallic gold appears only in highlights and accents. On a black ground, specular highlights are the only thing that separates materials from one another — so they must be crisp and sufficient, and every metallic element needs one clear reflection. A single dramatic key light. Luxurious, ceremonial. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 墨黑金配色：接近纯黑的底色撑起画面，金属金只出现在高光与点缀里。在黑底上，高光是把不同材质区分开来的唯一东西——所以高光必须锐利且足够，每件金属物都要有一处明确的反射。用一个戏剧性的主光。奢华、有仪式感。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 柔和、微暖、有质感。适合美妆、服饰、生活方式。
palettes.desc: 带灰的低饱和粉，避开粉红甜腻的坑。是「高级粉」的正解。
palettes.note: 粉色主导时肤色会撞色，需要把人物肤色往灰里压一点
palettes.demo: dusty pink palette, low saturation muted pink dominant, warm grey secondary tones, soft diffused light, gentle refined feminine mood
palettes.gpt: A dusty pink palette with a low-saturation muted pink dominant over warm grey secondaries, lit by soft diffused light. Because pink competes with skin tone, desaturate the figures slightly and push their skin toward grey — otherwise faces and background merge into one pink mass. Gentle, refined, feminine without sweetness. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 灰粉配色：低饱和的豆沙粉占主导，配暖灰辅助色，柔和漫射光。因为粉色会与肤色相撞，把人物略降饱和并把肤色往灰里推，否则脸和背景会糊成同一团粉色。柔和、有质感、有女性气质但不发甜。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 质朴、厚重、有土感。适合复古、乡村、陶器、手作。
palettes.desc: 红棕偏橙的土色，像陶土与旧木。适合手工与复古题材。
palettes.note: 土色系最容易显脏，画面里要有一处干净的高光或纯色来提气
palettes.demo: raw sienna palette, earthy terracotta and rust brown dominant, deep charcoal brown secondary, natural material textures, one clean light area to lift the tone
palettes.gpt: A raw sienna palette of earthy terracotta and rust brown over deep charcoal brown, on natural material textures. Earth tones are the easiest to make look dirty, so the frame needs one clean, lighter area — a pale wall, a clear sky, a piece of unweathered material — to lift the whole image and give it air. Rustic, grounded. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 赭石配色：红棕与铁锈色的土色为主，压深炭棕辅助，放在自然材质肌理上。土色系最容易显脏，所以画面里必须有一块干净的亮区——一面浅墙、一片晴空、一件没被风化的材料——把整幅提起来、给它空气。质朴、有根。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 冷淡、克制、有距离感。适合都市、科技、冬季、纪实。
palettes.desc: 带蓝的灰绿，气质清冷。是都市题材最合适的底色之一。
palettes.note: 青灰主导时需要一个暖点缀，否则整个画面会像没有情绪
palettes.demo: slate teal palette, muted blue green dominant, cool neutral secondaries, overcast diffuse lighting, one small warm accent, restrained urban mood
palettes.gpt: A slate teal palette of muted blue-green over cool neutral secondaries, lit by flat overcast diffusion. Because this scheme is inherently emotionally cool, it needs exactly one small warm accent — a lit window, a sodium street lamp, a piece of worn leather — or the whole image reads as having no mood at all. Restrained, urban, slightly cold. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 青灰配色：低饱和的蓝绿为主，压冷中性色辅助，用阴天平漫射光。因为这套调子本来就情绪偏冷，它需要一个恰好大小的暖点缀——一扇亮着的窗、一盏钠灯、一块磨旧的皮革——否则整幅会读成完全没有情绪。克制、都市、微冷。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 梦幻、柔和、有雾气。适合夜景、回忆、童话、抒情。
palettes.desc: 带灰的淡紫，介于冷与暖之间。有雾感，适合表达回忆与梦境。
palettes.note: 紫色在暗部容易发黑，要保证暗部也带一点紫而不是纯黑
palettes.demo: lavender mist palette, soft muted violet dominant, pale lilac and cream secondaries, diffused dreamy lighting, hazy low contrast, ethereal nostalgic mood
palettes.gpt: A lavender mist palette: a soft muted violet dominant over pale lilac and cream, lit with diffused dreamy light at hazy low contrast. Violet turns muddy black in the shadows if you let it — keep the shadow side of every form tinted violet rather than neutral grey. Ethereal, nostalgic, on the edge of waking. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 薰衣草配色：柔和的低饱和紫为主导，配淡紫与奶油色，用梦幻的漫射光，压低对比做出雾感。紫色在暗部不控制就会发黑发浑——每个形体的暗面都要带紫，而不是中性灰。梦幻、怀旧、像在清醒边缘。不要写字。

palettes.mood: 明快、有反差、有点怪趣。适合潮流、年轻、创意。
palettes.desc: 极亮的黄绿色，用深中性色压住。冲击力强但需要克制的背景。
palettes.note: 黄绿亮度极高，只能做点缀或小面积主体，大面积用会刺眼
palettes.demo: lemon lime palette, bright yellow green used sparingly as a pop color against a deep neutral backdrop, high contrast, sharp edges, youthful energetic mood
palettes.gpt: A lemon lime palette: a bright yellow-green used deliberately sparingly as a pop color against a deep neutral backdrop. Because of its extreme value it must stay limited in area — used broadly it becomes harsh and tiring. Reserve it for one or two focal points and let everything else stay dark and quiet. Youthful, energetic, slightly odd. No lettering.
palettes.gptZh: 柠檬绿配色：明亮的黄绿作为点缀色，刻意少面积地用在深中性背景上。因为明度极高，它必须控制面积——大面积使用会刺眼又疲劳。只留一两个焦点给它，其余部分保持安静深暗。年轻、有能量、带一点古怪。不要写字。
